source.text: וַיִּשְׁלַ֨ח יְחִזְקִיָּ֜הוּ עַל־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל וִֽיהוּדָ֗ה וְגַֽם־אִגְּרוֹת֙ כָּתַב֙ עַל־אֶפְרַ֣יִם וּמְנַשֶּׁ֔ה לָב֥וֹא לְבֵית־יְהוָ֖ה בִּֽירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת פֶּ֔סַח לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And sent Hezekiah to all Israel and Judah, and also letters he wrote to Ephraim and Manasseh, to come to [the] house of Yahweh in Jerusalem to do [a] Passover to Yahweh God of Israel.

en.L: And Hezekiah sent to all Israel and Judah, and he also wrote letters to Ephraim and Manasseh, to come to the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in Jerusalem to keep a Passover to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the God of Israel.
en.B: Hezekiah sent word to all Israel and Judah, and wrote letters as well to Ephraim and Manasseh, calling them to come to Jerusalem, to the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, to keep the Passover for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel.
en.R: Hezekiah sent messages to all the people of Israel and Judah. He also wrote letters to the tribes of Ephraim and Manasseh. He invited them to come to the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in Jerusalem and celebrate the Passover in honor of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel.

es.L: Y Ezequías envió a todo Israel y Judá, y también escribió cartas a Efraín y a Manasés, para que vinieran a la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} en Jerusalén a celebrar la Pascua {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel.
es.B: Ezequías envió aviso a todo Israel y Judá, y escribió además cartas a Efraín y a Manasés, llamándolos a venir a Jerusalén, a la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, para celebrar la Pascua en honor {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel.
es.R: Ezequías envió mensajes a toda la gente de Israel y de Judá. También escribió cartas a las tribus de Efraín y Manasés. Los invitó a venir al templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} en Jerusalén para celebrar la Pascua en honor {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel.

fr.L: Et Ézéchias envoya [dire] à tout Israël et à Juda, et il écrivit aussi des lettres à Éphraïm et à Manassé, de venir à la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} à Jérusalem pour célébrer une Pâque {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël.
fr.B: Ézéchias envoya des messagers à tout Israël et à Juda, et il écrivit aussi des lettres à Éphraïm et à Manassé, pour les inviter à venir à Jérusalem, à la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, célébrer la Pâque en l’honneur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël.
fr.R: Ézéchias a envoyé des messages à tout le peuple d’Israël et de Juda. Il a aussi écrit des lettres aux tribus d’Éphraïm et de Manassé. Il les a invités à venir au temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} à Jérusalem pour célébrer la Pâque en l’honneur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël.

sw.L: Hezekia akatuma kwa Israeli wote na Yuda, tena akaandika barua kwa Efraimu na Manase, waje katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huko Yerusalemu ili kumfanyia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wa Israeli Pasaka.
sw.B: Hezekia alituma ujumbe kwa Israeli wote na Yuda, akaandika pia barua kwa Efraimu na Manase, akiwaita waje Yerusalemu, kwenye nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ili kumfanyia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, Pasaka.
sw.R: Hezekia alituma ujumbe kwa watu wote wa Israeli na Yuda. Aliandika pia barua kwa makabila ya Efraimu na Manase. Aliwaalika waje kwenye hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huko Yerusalemu na kusherehekea Pasaka kwa heshima ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli.

vi.L: Ê-xê-chia sai [người] đến cả Y-sơ-ra-ên và Giu-đa, và cũng viết thư cho Ép-ra-im và Ma-na-se, để họ đến nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tại Giê-ru-sa-lem mà giữ Lễ Vượt Qua cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Ê-xê-chia sai người báo tin cho cả Y-sơ-ra-ên và Giu-đa, và cũng viết thư cho Ép-ra-im và Ma-na-se, mời họ đến nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tại Giê-ru-sa-lem để giữ Lễ Vượt Qua cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Ê-xê-chia gửi thông báo cho toàn dân Y-sơ-ra-ên và Giu-đa. Vua cũng viết thư cho các chi tộc Ép-ra-im và Ma-na-se. Vua mời họ đến đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tại Giê-ru-sa-lem để mừng Lễ Vượt Qua tôn vinh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 히스기야가 온 이스라엘과 유다에 [사람을] 보내고, 에브라임과 므낫세에도 편지들을 써서, 예루살렘에 있는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 와서 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 유월절을 지키라고 했다.
ko.B: 히스기야는 온 이스라엘과 유다에 사람을 보내고, 에브라임과 므낫세에도 편지를 써 보내어, 예루살렘에 있는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 와서 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 유월절을 지키라고 불렀다.
ko.R: 히스기야는 이스라엘과 유다의 모든 백성에게 소식을 보냈다. 그는 에브라임 지파와 므낫세 지파에게도 편지를 써 보냈다. 그는 그들에게 예루살렘에 있는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에 와서 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 유월절을 지키자고 초대했다.

pt.L: E Ezequias mandou [mensageiros] a todo o Israel e Judá, e também escreveu cartas a Efraim e Manassés, para que viessem à casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} em Jerusalém, para celebrar a Páscoa {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o Deus de Israel.
pt.B: Ezequias mandou avisar todo o Israel e Judá, e escreveu também cartas a Efraim e Manassés, chamando-os a vir a Jerusalém, à casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, para celebrar a Páscoa em honra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o Deus de Israel.
pt.R: Ezequias mandou mensagens a todo o povo de Israel e de Judá. Também escreveu cartas às tribos de Efraim e Manassés. Ele os convidou a vir ao templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} em Jerusalém e celebrar a Páscoa em honra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o Deus de Israel.

decisions.choice: all Israel and Judah; Ephraim and Manasseh: the whole people, the northern tribes included
decisions.reason: Ephraim and Manasseh were the leading tribes of the northern kingdom, which had broken away from David's house (10:16-19). The kings of Assyria had already taken many of its people away (verse 6; 2 Kings 15:29; 17:6). Hezekiah, in his first year (29:3), calls everyone who is left in the north to worship again at the temple in Jerusalem, as one people with Judah.

decisions.choice: a Passover: the yearly feast that remembered the night Yahweh brought Israel out of Egypt
decisions.reason: The Passover lamb was killed on the fourteenth day of the first month and eaten that night (Exodus 12:1-14). The law said it was to be kept at the place Yahweh would choose for his name (Deuteronomy 16:2, 5-6), which is why the people are called to Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: sent word ... calling them (Balanced); sent messages ... He invited them (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only that Hezekiah "sent" and that the letters were "to come". Balanced and Readable supply what he sent and say plainly that the letters were an invitation. Readable adds "the tribes of" so the names are not read as people, and says "temple" for "house of Yahweh".

decisions.choice: "la Pascua"; "celebrar"
decisions.reason: The Passover as the terms note names it; Spanish "celebrar la Pascua" at every level for "do a Passover".

decisions.choice: "la Pâque"
decisions.reason: The feast of Exodus 12, never the Christian "Pâques", as the French style guide and the Kings terms note set.

decisions.choice: "Lễ Vượt Qua"
decisions.reason: The name of the feast as the Vietnamese Pentateuch and the Gospels give it, capitalised as a name.

decisions.choice: Ezequias; a Páscoa; em honra do SENHOR (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Ezequias" as 2 Kings 18:1 in Portuguese and the Kings list of names; "a Páscoa" as the Old Testament terms. Balanced and Readable say "celebrar a Páscoa em honra do SENHOR", the wording Exodus 12:48 has in Portuguese for keeping the Passover "to" Yahweh (m2); Literal keeps the bare "ao SENHOR". Chapters 30-32 follow 2 Kings 18-20 in Portuguese where Chronicles repeats Kings.

source.text: וַיִּוָּעַ֨ץ הַמֶּ֧לֶךְ וְשָׂרָ֛יו וְכָל־הַקָּהָ֖ל בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת הַפֶּ֖סַח בַּחֹ֥דֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And took counsel the king and his princes and all the assembly in Jerusalem to do the Passover in the month the second.

en.L: And the king and his princes and all the assembly in Jerusalem took counsel to keep the Passover in the second month.
en.B: The king, his officials and the whole assembly in Jerusalem decided to keep the Passover in the second month.
en.R: The king, his leaders and all the people gathered in Jerusalem agreed to celebrate the Passover in the second month.

es.L: Y el rey y sus príncipes y toda la asamblea en Jerusalén tomaron consejo para celebrar la Pascua en el mes segundo.
es.B: El rey, sus jefes y toda la asamblea en Jerusalén decidieron celebrar la Pascua en el mes segundo.
es.R: El rey, sus dirigentes y toda la gente reunida en Jerusalén se pusieron de acuerdo para celebrar la Pascua en el mes segundo.

fr.L: Et le roi, et ses princes, et toute l’assemblée à Jérusalem tinrent conseil pour célébrer la Pâque au deuxième mois.
fr.B: Le roi, ses chefs et toute l’assemblée à Jérusalem décidèrent de célébrer la Pâque au deuxième mois.
fr.R: Le roi, ses chefs et tous les gens rassemblés à Jérusalem ont décidé de célébrer la Pâque au deuxième mois.

sw.L: Mfalme na wakuu wake na kusanyiko lote katika Yerusalemu wakafanya shauri kufanya Pasaka katika mwezi wa pili.
sw.B: Mfalme, maafisa wake na kusanyiko lote katika Yerusalemu waliamua kufanya Pasaka katika mwezi wa pili.
sw.R: Mfalme, viongozi wake na watu wote waliokusanyika Yerusalemu walikubaliana kusherehekea Pasaka katika mwezi wa pili.

vi.L: Vua, các thủ lĩnh của vua và cả hội chúng tại Giê-ru-sa-lem bàn bạc để giữ Lễ Vượt Qua vào tháng thứ hai.
vi.B: Vua, các quan chức của vua và cả hội chúng tại Giê-ru-sa-lem quyết định giữ Lễ Vượt Qua vào tháng thứ hai.
vi.R: Vua, các người lãnh đạo của vua và mọi người tụ họp tại Giê-ru-sa-lem đồng ý mừng Lễ Vượt Qua vào tháng thứ hai.

ko.L: 그리고 왕과 그의 지도자들과 예루살렘의 온 회중이 둘째 달에 유월절을 지키기로 의논했다.
ko.B: 왕과 관리들과 예루살렘의 온 회중은 의논한 끝에 둘째 달에 유월절을 지키기로 결정했다.
ko.R: 왕과 지도자들과 예루살렘에 모인 모든 백성은 둘째 달에 유월절을 지키기로 뜻을 모았다.

pt.L: E o rei, e os seus príncipes, e toda a assembleia em Jerusalém tomaram conselho para celebrar a Páscoa no segundo mês.
pt.B: O rei, os seus oficiais e toda a assembleia em Jerusalém decidiram celebrar a Páscoa no segundo mês.
pt.R: O rei, os seus líderes e todo o povo reunido em Jerusalém concordaram em celebrar a Páscoa no segundo mês.

decisions.choice: in the second month: the law's provision for a later Passover
decisions.reason: The Passover belonged to the first month (Exodus 12:2, 6). Numbers 9:10-11 allowed anyone who was unclean from a dead body or far away on a journey to keep it a month later, on the fourteenth day of the second month. Here the king and the assembly apply that provision to the whole nation, for the reasons given in verse 3.

decisions.choice: took counsel: they consulted together and decided
decisions.reason: The verb means to take advice and come to a decision. The choice was made in council by the king, his officials and the people gathered in Jerusalem, as David consulted the assembly before bringing up the ark (1 Chronicles 13:1-4).

decisions.choice: his princes (Literal); his officials (Balanced); his leaders (Readable)
decisions.reason: The word for the king's chief men follows the wording used across these books: "princes", "officials", "leaders".

decisions.choice: "príncipes" (L); "jefes" (B); "dirigentes" (R)
decisions.reason: The king's chief men keep one word per level through this block, as the English has "princes", "officials" and "leaders".

decisions.choice: príncipes (L), oficiais (B), líderes (R); no segundo mês
decisions.reason: The king's chief men take the three words 12:6 uses in Portuguese, following the English levels. "No segundo mês" is the wording of Numbers 9:11 in Portuguese, the law of the later Passover that the meaning note names (m1), so the reader can hear the link.

source.text: כִּ֣י לֹ֧א יָכְל֛וּ לַעֲשֹׂת֖וֹ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֑יא כִּ֤י הַכֹּהֲנִים֙ לֹֽא־הִתְקַדְּשׁ֣וּ לְמַ דַּ֔יוְהָעָ֖ם לֹא־נֶאֶסְפ֥וּלִֽירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: For not they were able to do it at the time the that, for the priests not had consecrated themselves to [what was] enough, and the people not had gathered to Jerusalem.

en.L: For they had not been able to keep it at that time, because the priests had not consecrated themselves in sufficient [number], and the people had not gathered to Jerusalem.
en.B: They had not been able to keep it at the usual time, because too few priests had consecrated themselves and the people had not yet gathered in Jerusalem.
en.R: They had not been able to celebrate it at the usual time, in the first month. Not enough priests had made themselves holy for the work, and the people had not come together in Jerusalem.

es.L: Porque no habían podido celebrarla en aquel tiempo, porque los sacerdotes no se habían santificado en número suficiente, y el pueblo no se había reunido en Jerusalén.
es.B: No habían podido celebrarla en el tiempo de costumbre, porque muy pocos sacerdotes se habían santificado y el pueblo todavía no se había reunido en Jerusalén.
es.R: No habían podido celebrarla en el tiempo de costumbre, en el mes primero. No había suficientes sacerdotes purificados para el trabajo, y la gente no se había reunido en Jerusalén.

fr.L: Car ils n’avaient pas pu la célébrer en ce temps-là, parce que les prêtres ne s’étaient pas consacrés en [nombre] suffisant, et que le peuple ne s’était pas rassemblé à Jérusalem.
fr.B: Ils n’avaient pas pu la célébrer au moment habituel, parce que trop peu de prêtres s’étaient consacrés et que le peuple ne s’était pas encore rassemblé à Jérusalem.
fr.R: Ils n’avaient pas pu la célébrer au moment habituel, au premier mois. Pas assez de prêtres s’étaient rendus saints pour le service, et le peuple ne s’était pas réuni à Jérusalem.

sw.L: Kwa maana hawakuweza kuifanya wakati ule, kwa sababu makuhani walikuwa hawajajitakasa kwa [idadi] ya kutosha, wala watu walikuwa hawajakusanyika Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Hawakuwa wameweza kuifanya kwa wakati wake wa kawaida, kwa sababu makuhani waliokuwa wamejitakasa walikuwa wachache mno, na watu walikuwa bado hawajakusanyika Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Hawakuwa wameweza kuisherehekea kwa wakati wake wa kawaida, yaani katika mwezi wa kwanza. Makuhani waliokuwa wamejifanya watakatifu kwa ajili ya kazi hiyo hawakutosha, na watu walikuwa hawajakusanyika Yerusalemu.

vi.L: Vì họ đã không thể giữ lễ vào lúc ấy, bởi các thầy tế lễ chưa thánh hóa chính mình đủ [số], và dân chúng chưa nhóm lại tại Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Họ đã không thể giữ lễ vào đúng kỳ, vì có quá ít thầy tế lễ đã thánh hóa chính mình, và dân chúng chưa nhóm lại tại Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: Họ đã không thể mừng lễ vào đúng kỳ, tức là vào tháng thứ nhất. Không đủ thầy tế lễ đã làm cho mình nên thánh để làm việc, và dân chúng chưa tụ họp tại Giê-ru-sa-lem.

ko.L: 그때에 그것을 지킬 수 없었기 때문이다. 제사장들이 충분히 자신을 거룩하게 하지 못했고, 백성이 예루살렘에 모이지 못했기 때문이다.
ko.B: 정해진 때에는 유월절을 지킬 수 없었기 때문이다. 자신을 거룩하게 한 제사장들이 너무 적었고, 백성도 아직 예루살렘에 모이지 않았다.
ko.R: 정해진 때인 첫째 달에는 유월절을 지킬 수 없었기 때문이다. 일할 만큼 많은 제사장들이 아직 자신을 거룩하게 하지 못했고, 백성도 예루살렘에 모이지 못했다.

pt.L: Porque não puderam celebrá-la naquele tempo, pois os sacerdotes não tinham se consagrado em [número] suficiente, e o povo não tinha se reunido em Jerusalém.
pt.B: Não tinham podido celebrá-la na época própria, porque poucos sacerdotes tinham se consagrado e o povo ainda não tinha se reunido em Jerusalém.
pt.R: Eles não tinham conseguido celebrá-la na época certa, no primeiro mês. Poucos sacerdotes tinham se santificado para o trabalho, e o povo não tinha se reunido em Jerusalém.

decisions.choice: at that time: at the proper time, the fourteenth day of the first month
decisions.reason: "That time" is the time the law set for the Passover (Exodus 12:6; Leviticus 23:5). In Hezekiah's first year the temple was still being cleansed until the sixteenth day of the first month (29:17), so the feast could not be held on the fourteenth.

decisions.choice: had not consecrated themselves in sufficient number: too few priests were ready
decisions.reason: The phrase means "as much as was enough". It is the number of priests that fell short, as 29:34 says: there were too few priests to skin all the burnt offerings, and the Levites had been more careful to consecrate themselves than the priests. To consecrate oneself was to make oneself ritually clean and fit to serve.

decisions.choice: the usual time (Balanced); the usual time, in the first month (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "that time" refers to (m1); Readable names the month.

decisions.choice: se consagrar (L, B); se santificar (R)
decisions.reason: The priests' self-consecration (m2) is "consagrar-se" at Literal and Balanced and "santificar-se" at Readable, the words 5:11 uses in Portuguese; "purificar-se" is kept for the different verb of cleansing in verse 18.

source.text: וַיִּישַׁ֥ר הַדָּבָ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֣י הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וּבְעֵינֵ֖י כָּל־הַקָּהָֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And was right the thing in [the] eyes of the king and in [the] eyes of all the assembly.

en.L: And the thing was right in the eyes of the king and in the eyes of all the assembly.
en.B: The plan seemed right to the king and to the whole assembly.
en.R: The king and all the people agreed that this was a good plan.

es.L: Y la cosa fue recta a los ojos del rey y a los ojos de toda la asamblea.
es.B: El plan les pareció bien al rey y a toda la asamblea.
es.R: El rey y toda la gente estuvieron de acuerdo en que era un buen plan.

fr.L: Et la chose fut droite aux yeux du roi et aux yeux de toute l’assemblée.
fr.B: Ce projet parut juste au roi et à toute l’assemblée.
fr.R: Le roi et tout le peuple ont trouvé que c’était une bonne idée.

sw.L: Jambo hilo likawa sawa machoni pa mfalme na machoni pa kusanyiko lote.
sw.B: Mpango huo ulionekana kuwa mzuri kwa mfalme na kwa kusanyiko lote.
sw.R: Mfalme na watu wote walikubaliana kwamba huo ulikuwa mpango mzuri.

vi.L: Việc ấy là đúng trong mắt vua và trong mắt cả hội chúng.
vi.B: Kế hoạch ấy có vẻ đúng đối với vua và cả hội chúng.
vi.R: Vua và toàn dân đều đồng ý rằng đó là một kế hoạch tốt.

ko.L: 그리고 그 일이 왕의 눈과 온 회중의 눈에 옳았다.
ko.B: 왕과 온 회중은 그 계획이 옳다고 여겼다.
ko.R: 왕과 모든 백성은 그것이 좋은 계획이라고 생각했다.

pt.L: E a coisa foi reta aos olhos do rei e aos olhos de toda a assembleia.
pt.B: O plano pareceu certo ao rei e a toda a assembleia.
pt.R: O rei e todo o povo concordaram que era um bom plano.

decisions.choice: was right in the eyes of: seemed good to, was approved by
decisions.reason: "Right in the eyes of" someone means that he judges it right. The king and the whole assembly agreed to the plan of verse 2.

decisions.choice: The plan seemed right to (Balanced); agreed that this was a good plan (Readable)
decisions.reason: The word is "thing" or "matter"; here it is the plan to keep the Passover in the second month. Balanced and Readable drop the picture of the eyes.

source.text: וַיַּֽעֲמִ֣ידוּ דָבָ֗ר לְהַעֲבִ֨יר ק֤וֹל בְּכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מִבְּאֵֽר־שֶׁ֣בַע וְעַד־דָּ֔ן לָב֞וֹא לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת פֶּ֛סַח לַיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כִּ֣י לֹ֥א לָרֹ֛ב עָשׂ֖וּ כַּכָּתֽוּב׃

records.literal_gloss: And they established [a] word to make pass [a] voice in all Israel from Beersheba and to Dan, to come to do Passover to Yahweh God of Israel in Jerusalem, for not to multitude they had done as written.

en.L: And they established a decree to make a proclamation pass through all Israel, from Beersheba even to Dan, to come to keep a Passover to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the God of Israel in Jerusalem, for they had not kept [it] in multitude as [it is] written.
en.B: So they issued a decree to send a proclamation throughout all Israel, from Beersheba to Dan, that the people should come to Jerusalem to keep the Passover for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel. For they had not kept it in great numbers, as it is written.
en.R: So they made a decision to send an announcement through all Israel, from Beersheba in the far south to Dan in the far north. The people were to come to Jerusalem and celebrate the Passover in honor of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel. Not many people had been celebrating it in the way the law says.

es.L: Y establecieron decreto de hacer pasar pregón por todo Israel, desde Beerseba hasta Dan, para que vinieran a celebrar la Pascua {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel, en Jerusalén; porque no la habían celebrado en multitud, como está escrito.
es.B: Así que dieron la orden de enviar un pregón por todo Israel, desde Beerseba hasta Dan, para que la gente viniera a Jerusalén a celebrar la Pascua en honor {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel. Porque no la habían celebrado todos juntos, como está escrito.
es.R: Así que decidieron enviar un anuncio por todo Israel, desde Beerseba, en el extremo sur, hasta Dan, en el extremo norte. La gente debía venir a Jerusalén para celebrar la Pascua en honor {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, Dios de Israel. No era mucha la gente que la había estado celebrando como manda la ley.

fr.L: Et ils établirent une décision : faire passer une proclamation dans tout Israël, depuis Beer-Shéba jusqu’à Dan, pour venir célébrer une Pâque {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, à Jérusalem ; car ils ne l’avaient pas célébrée en grand nombre, comme il est écrit.
fr.B: Ils décidèrent donc de faire passer une proclamation dans tout Israël, de Beer-Shéba jusqu’à Dan, pour que le peuple vienne à Jérusalem célébrer la Pâque en l’honneur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël. Car on ne l’avait pas célébrée en grand nombre, comme il est écrit.
fr.R: Ils ont donc décidé d’envoyer une annonce dans tout Israël, de Beer-Shéba, tout au sud, jusqu’à Dan, tout au nord. Le peuple devait venir à Jérusalem pour célébrer la Pâque en l’honneur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël. Peu de gens l’avaient célébrée comme la loi le demande.

sw.L: Wakaweka azimio la kupitisha tangazo katika Israeli yote, tangu Beer-sheba mpaka Dani, kwamba waje kumfanyia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wa Israeli Pasaka huko Yerusalemu, kwa maana hawakuwa wameifanya kwa wingi kama ilivyoandikwa.
sw.B: Basi wakatoa amri ya kupeleka tangazo katika Israeli yote, tangu Beer-sheba mpaka Dani, kwamba watu waje Yerusalemu kumfanyia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, Pasaka. Kwa maana hawakuwa wameifanya kwa wingi, kama ilivyoandikwa.
sw.R: Basi wakaamua kupeleka tangazo katika Israeli yote, tangu Beer-sheba upande wa kusini kabisa mpaka Dani upande wa kaskazini kabisa. Watu walipaswa kuja Yerusalemu kusherehekea Pasaka kwa heshima ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli. Si watu wengi waliokuwa wakiisherehekea kwa namna ambayo sheria inasema.

vi.L: Họ ra một sắc lệnh để truyền rao khắp cả Y-sơ-ra-ên, từ Bê-e-Sê-ba đến Đan, rằng hãy đến giữ Lễ Vượt Qua cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, vì họ đã không giữ [lễ] đông đảo như đã chép.
vi.B: Vậy họ ban một sắc lệnh để loan báo khắp cả Y-sơ-ra-ên, từ Bê-e-Sê-ba đến Đan, rằng dân chúng phải đến Giê-ru-sa-lem giữ Lễ Vượt Qua cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên. Vì đã lâu họ không cùng nhau giữ lễ đông đảo như lời đã chép.
vi.R: Vậy họ quyết định gửi thông báo đi khắp Y-sơ-ra-ên, từ Bê-e-Sê-ba ở tận phía nam đến Đan ở tận phía bắc. Dân chúng phải đến Giê-ru-sa-lem mừng Lễ Vượt Qua tôn vinh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên. Đã lâu không có nhiều người giữ lễ này theo cách luật pháp dạy.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 브엘세바에서부터 단까지 온 이스라엘에 소리를 두루 전하기로 결정하여, 예루살렘으로 와서 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 유월절을 지키라고 했다. 그들이 기록된 대로 많은 무리로 지키지 않았기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그래서 그들은 브엘세바에서 단까지 온 이스라엘에 명령을 내려, 백성이 예루살렘으로 와서 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 유월절을 지키도록 알리게 했다. 그동안 기록된 대로 많은 사람이 함께 모여 유월절을 지키지 못했기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그래서 그들은 남쪽 끝 브엘세바에서 북쪽 끝 단까지 온 이스라엘에 소식을 보내기로 했다. 백성은 예루살렘으로 와서 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 유월절을 지켜야 했다. 그동안은 율법에 적힌 대로 유월절을 지키는 사람이 많지 않았다.

pt.L: E estabeleceram uma palavra, para fazer passar uma proclamação por todo o Israel, de Berseba até Dã, para que viessem celebrar a Páscoa {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o Deus de Israel, em Jerusalém; porque não a tinham celebrado em multidão, como [está] escrito.
pt.B: Então decretaram que se fizesse uma proclamação por todo o Israel, de Berseba até Dã, para que o povo viesse a Jerusalém celebrar a Páscoa em honra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o Deus de Israel. Pois não a tinham celebrado em grande número, como está escrito.
pt.R: Por isso decidiram mandar um anúncio por todo o Israel, de Berseba, no extremo sul, até Dã, no extremo norte. O povo devia vir a Jerusalém e celebrar a Páscoa em honra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, o Deus de Israel. Pouca gente vinha celebrando a festa do jeito que a lei manda.

decisions.choice: from Beersheba to Dan: the whole land, from its southern edge to its northern edge
decisions.reason: Beersheba was the town at the southern end of the land and Dan the town at the northern end. The usual order is "from Dan to Beersheba" (Judges 20:1; 1 Samuel 3:20; 2 Samuel 17:11). Chronicles turns it round here and in 1 Chronicles 21:2, starting from Judah's end. The call goes to the whole land, north as well as south.

decisions.choice: they had not kept it in great numbers: not by the whole people together
alternatives: they had not kept it for a long time
decisions.reason: The phrase is "not to multitude". Read with verse 13 and verse 26, it means that the Passover had not been kept by all Israel gathered together, as the law intended. It can also mean "not for a long time": the feast had been neglected for many years. Both fit the chapter; the sense of numbers is the more usual one for this phrase.

decisions.choice: as it is written: as the law of Moses prescribes
decisions.reason: The law called for all Israel to keep the Passover together at the place Yahweh would choose (Exodus 12:47; Deuteronomy 16:5-6). "As it is written" refers to that written law; see also verses 16 and 18.

decisions.choice: issued a decree to send a proclamation (Balanced); made a decision to send an announcement (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is "made stand a word to make pass a voice": they settled the matter and sent the call through the land. Readable adds "in the far south" and "in the far north", as at 1 Chronicles 21:2, so a reader knows why the two towns are named.

decisions.choice: de Berseba até Dã
decisions.reason: Chronicles turns the usual phrase round, starting from the south (m1), and Portuguese keeps its order: "de Berseba até Dã", with the names as the Pentateuch spells them. Readable adds "no extremo sul" and "no extremo norte", as the English does.

source.text: וַיֵּלְכוּ֩ הָרָצִ֨ים בָּֽאִגְּר֜וֹת מִיַּ֧ד הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ וְשָׂרָ֗יו בְּכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וִֽיהוּדָ֔ה וּכְמִצְוַ֥ת הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ לֵאמֹ֑ר בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל שׁ֚וּבוּאֶל־יְהוָ֗ה אֱלֹהֵי֙ אַבְרָהָם֙ יִצְחָ֣ק וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְיָשֹׁב֙ אֶל־הַפְּלֵיטָ֔ה הַנִּשְׁאֶ֣רֶת לָכֶ֔ם מִכַּ֖ף מַלְכֵ֥י אַשּֽׁוּר׃

records.literal_gloss: And went the runners with the letters from [the] hand of the king and his princes in all Israel and Judah, and according to [the] command of the king, saying, Sons of Israel, return to Yahweh God of Abraham, Isaac and Israel, and he will return to the escaped [ones], the [ones] remaining to you from [the] palm of [the] kings of Assyria.

en.L: And the runners went with the letters from the hand of the king and his princes through all Israel and Judah, and according to the command of the king, saying, "{{gender:Children|Sons}} of Israel, return to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the God of Abraham, Isaac and Israel, so that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} may return to the escaped [ones] who are left to you from the palm of the kings of Assyria.
en.B: The couriers went throughout all Israel and Judah with the letters from the king and his officials. As the king had commanded, they said, "{{gender:Israelites|Sons of Israel}}, return to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Abraham, Isaac and Israel, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will return to those of you who are left, who escaped from the grasp of the kings of Assyria.
en.R: The messengers took the letters from the king and his leaders and went through all Israel and Judah. As the king had ordered, they said, "{{gender:Israelites|Sons of Israel}}, come back to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Abraham, Isaac and Israel. Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will come back to you, the few who are left, who escaped from the kings of Assyria.

es.L: Y los correos fueron con las cartas de mano del rey y de sus príncipes por todo Israel y Judá, y según el mandato del rey, diciendo: «Hijos de Israel, {{plural_you:vuelvan|volved}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, el Dios de Abraham, de Isaac y de Israel, para que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se vuelva al remanente que {{plural_you:les|os}} ha quedado de la mano de los reyes de Asiria.
es.B: Los correos recorrieron todo Israel y Judá con las cartas del rey y de sus jefes. Como el rey lo había mandado, decían: «Israelitas, {{plural_you:vuelvan|volved}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, el Dios de Abraham, de Isaac y de Israel, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se volverá a los que {{plural_you:quedan|quedáis}}, a los que {{plural_you:escaparon|escapasteis}} del poder de los reyes de Asiria.
es.R: Los mensajeros tomaron las cartas del rey y de sus dirigentes y recorrieron todo Israel y Judá. Como el rey lo había ordenado, decían: «Israelitas, {{plural_you:vuelvan|volved}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, el Dios de Abraham, de Isaac y de Israel. Entonces {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} volverá a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, los pocos que {{plural_you:quedan|quedáis}}, los que {{plural_you:escaparon|escapasteis}} de los reyes de Asiria.

fr.L: Et les coureurs allèrent avec les lettres de la main du roi et de ses princes dans tout Israël et Juda, et selon l’ordre du roi, en disant : « {{gender:Enfants|Fils}} d’Israël, revenez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Abraham, d’Isaac et d’Israël, afin qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} revienne vers les rescapés qui vous restent de la main des rois d’Assyrie.
fr.B: Les courriers parcoururent tout Israël et Juda avec les lettres du roi et de ses chefs. Selon l’ordre du roi, ils disaient : « {{gender:Israélites|Fils d’Israël}}, revenez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Abraham, d’Isaac et d’Israël, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} reviendra vers ceux d’entre vous qui restent, qui ont échappé à la poigne des rois d’Assyrie.
fr.R: Les messagers ont pris les lettres du roi et de ses chefs, et ils sont allés dans tout Israël et Juda. Comme le roi l’avait ordonné, ils disaient : « {{gender:Israélites|Fils d’Israël}}, revenez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Abraham, d’Isaac et d’Israël. Alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} reviendra vers vous, le petit nombre qui reste, ceux qui ont échappé aux rois d’Assyrie.

sw.L: Wakimbiaji wakaenda na zile barua kutoka mkononi mwa mfalme na wakuu wake katika Israeli yote na Yuda, na sawasawa na amri ya mfalme, wakisema, "Enyi wana wa Israeli, mrudieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wa Abrahamu, Isaka na Israeli, ili naye awarudie waliookoka, waliobaki kwenu kutoka kiganjani mwa wafalme wa Ashuru.
sw.B: Wajumbe walikwenda katika Israeli yote na Yuda wakiwa na barua kutoka kwa mfalme na maafisa wake. Kama mfalme alivyoamuru, walisema, "Enyi Waisraeli, mrudieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Abrahamu, Isaka na Israeli, naye atawarudia wale wenu waliobaki, walioponyoka mkononi mwa wafalme wa Ashuru.
sw.R: Wajumbe walichukua barua kutoka kwa mfalme na viongozi wake, wakapita katika Israeli yote na Yuda. Kama mfalme alivyoagiza, walisema, "Enyi Waisraeli, mrudieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Abrahamu, Isaka na Israeli. Ndipo naye atawarudia ninyi, wachache mliobaki, mlioponyoka mikononi mwa wafalme wa Ashuru.

vi.L: Các người chạy thư đem thư từ tay vua và các thủ lĩnh của vua đi khắp Y-sơ-ra-ên và Giu-đa, theo lệnh vua, mà nói: "Hỡi con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên, hãy trở lại với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Áp-ra-ham, Y-sác và Y-sơ-ra-ên, để {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trở lại với những người thoát nạn còn sót lại của các ngươi khỏi tay các vua A-si-ri.
vi.B: Các người đưa thư đem thư của vua và các quan chức đi khắp Y-sơ-ra-ên và Giu-đa. Theo lệnh vua, họ nói: "Hỡi dân Y-sơ-ra-ên, hãy trở lại với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Áp-ra-ham, Y-sác và Y-sơ-ra-ên, thì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ trở lại với anh em, những người còn sót lại, đã thoát khỏi tay các vua A-si-ri.
vi.R: Những người đưa tin cầm thư của vua và các người lãnh đạo đi khắp Y-sơ-ra-ên và Giu-đa. Theo lệnh vua, họ nói: "Hỡi dân Y-sơ-ra-ên, hãy trở về với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Áp-ra-ham, Y-sác và Y-sơ-ra-ên. Khi ấy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ trở lại với anh em, là số ít người còn sót lại, đã thoát khỏi tay các vua A-si-ri.

ko.L: 그리고 달리는 자들이 왕과 그의 지도자들의 손에서 [받은] 편지들을 가지고 온 이스라엘과 유다를 두루 다니며, 왕의 명령대로 말했다. "이스라엘 자손들아, 아브라함과 이삭과 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께로 돌아오너라. 그러면 그분께서 앗시리아 왕들의 손바닥에서 피하여 너희에게 남아 있는 자들에게로 돌아오실 것이다.
ko.B: 전령들이 왕과 관리들이 쓴 편지를 가지고 온 이스라엘과 유다를 두루 다니며, 왕이 명령한 대로 말했다. "이스라엘 자손들아, 아브라함과 이삭과 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께로 돌아오너라. 그러면 그분께서도 앗시리아 왕들의 손에서 벗어나 살아남은 너희에게로 돌아오실 것이다.
ko.R: 전령들이 왕과 지도자들이 쓴 편지를 가지고 이스라엘과 유다 곳곳을 다녔다. 그들은 왕이 명령한 대로 말했다. "이스라엘 사람들아, 아브라함과 이삭과 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께로 돌아오너라. 그러면 그분께서도 너희에게로 돌아오실 것이다. 너희는 앗시리아 왕들에게서 벗어나 살아남은 얼마 안 되는 사람들이다.

pt.L: E os corredores foram com as cartas da mão do rei e dos seus príncipes por todo o Israel e Judá, e segundo a ordem do rei, dizendo: "Filhos de Israel, voltem para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de Abraão, Isaque e Israel, para que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} volte para os escapados que restaram a vocês da palma dos reis da Assíria.
pt.B: Os mensageiros percorreram todo o Israel e Judá com as cartas do rei e dos seus oficiais. Conforme o rei tinha ordenado, eles diziam: "Israelitas, voltem para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de Abraão, Isaque e Israel, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} voltará para vocês que restaram, que escaparam das garras dos reis da Assíria.
pt.R: Os mensageiros levaram as cartas do rei e dos seus líderes e percorreram todo o Israel e Judá. Como o rei tinha mandado, eles diziam: "Israelitas, voltem para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de Abraão, Isaque e Israel. Então {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} voltará para vocês, os poucos que restaram, que escaparam dos reis da Assíria.

decisions.choice: the runners: royal couriers
decisions.reason: The word means "those who run". Kings kept runners as guards and messengers (2 Chronicles 12:10-11); here they carry the king's letters through the land.

decisions.choice: return to Yahweh, so that he may return to you
decisions.reason: The same verb is used twice: if the people turn back to Yahweh, he will turn back to them. Verses 8-9 use it again. The prophets make the same call (Zechariah 1:3; Malachi 3:7). To return to Yahweh here means to come back to worship him at his temple and to serve him (verse 8).

decisions.choice: the escaped who are left from the kings of Assyria: the survivors in the north
decisions.reason: Assyrian kings had invaded the northern kingdom more than once. Tiglath-pileser took the people of Galilee and Gilead into exile (2 Kings 15:29), and when Samaria fell the king of Assyria carried Israel away (2 Kings 17:6). The letter speaks to those who were left in the land.

decisions.choice: the God of Abraham, Isaac and Israel: the God of the fathers of all the tribes
decisions.reason: Calling Jacob "Israel" reminds north and south alike that they come from one father and belong to one God, as in David's prayer (1 Chronicles 29:18) and Elijah's (1 Kings 18:36).

decisions.choice: couriers (Balanced); messengers (Readable); the grasp of (Balanced)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "runners" and "the palm of". Balanced says "couriers" and "the grasp of"; Readable says "messengers" and leaves out the picture of the hand. "Sons of Israel" follows the wording used across these books.

decisions.choice: plural_you through Hezekiah's letter; "Hijos de Israel" (L); "Israelitas" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The letter speaks to the whole people, so every "you" in verses 6-9 is plural. Spanish "hijos" and "israelitas" already include women, so the English gender setting has no Spanish counterpart.

decisions.choice: "los correos" (L, B); "los mensajeros" (R)
decisions.reason: The royal runners were couriers (m1); Spanish "correos" is the old word for them, and Readable says "mensajeros", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "les coureurs" (Literal); "les courriers" (Balanced); "les messagers" (Readable)
decisions.reason: Here the runners carry letters, so Balanced and Readable say "courriers" and "messagers" rather than the "gardes" used for the king's guard in Kings.

decisions.choice: wakimbiaji (L); wajumbe (B, R)
decisions.reason: The runners here carry letters, so Balanced and Readable call them "wajumbe" (messengers), not "walinzi" (guards) as in 2 Kings 11.

decisions.choice: wana wa Israeli (L); Waisraeli (B, R); no gender span
decisions.reason: The Swahili names cover the whole people, men and women, so no gender span is needed in this chapter (also verses 7, 9, 11).

decisions.choice: the king's letter calls the people "con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên" (L), "dân Y-sơ-ra-ên" (B, R) and "các ngươi" (L), "anh em" (B, R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: A king appealing to his own people, as Jehoshaphat in 20:20; the Vietnamese words already include men and women.

decisions.choice: "trở lại ... trở lại"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew uses one verb for the people's return and God's (m2); Vietnamese keeps the echo.

decisions.choice: "돌아오다" for both returns, the people's and Yahweh's, through verse 9
decisions.reason: The same verb is used both ways in the Hebrew (m2), so one Korean verb keeps the call and the promise linked; "이스라엘 자손" is inclusive, so no gender span is needed, as at 28:3.

decisions.choice: The king's letter speaks to the people in 해라체 ("돌아오너라")
decisions.reason: A royal proclamation to the people uses the plain style, as the king speaks to his subjects throughout Samuel and Kings.

decisions.choice: voltem para ... volte (L), voltará (B, R) para
decisions.reason: The same verb is used twice (m2), so Portuguese uses "voltar" both times at every level, and again in verses 8-9: the people's turning and Yahweh's are one word, as the call reads in the prophets. The couriers address the people as "vocês".

decisions.choice: os corredores (L), os mensageiros (B, R); Filhos de Israel (L), Israelitas (B, R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "corredores", the royal runners (m1); Balanced and Readable say "mensageiros", as "correio" for a courier is dated. As the Old Testament terms set it and 5:2 follows them, the people are "os filhos de Israel" (L) and "os israelitas" (B, R), with no setting: "filhos" already includes daughters and "israelitas" names everyone.

source.text: וְאַל־תִּֽהְי֗וּ כַּאֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶם֙ וְכַ֣אֲחֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָעֲל֔וּ בַּיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבוֹתֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּתְּנֵ֣ם לְשַׁמָּ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר אַתֶּ֥ם רֹאִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And not be like your fathers and like your brothers who acted unfaithfully against Yahweh God of their fathers, and he gave them to horror, as you [are] seeing.

en.L: And do not be like your fathers and like your brothers, who acted unfaithfully against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the God of their fathers, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave them up to horror, as you see.
en.B: Do not be like your ancestors and your {{gender:relatives|brothers}}, who were unfaithful to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of their ancestors, so that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made them an object of horror, as you see for yourselves.
en.R: Do not be like your ancestors and your {{gender:relatives|brothers}}. They were not loyal to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of their ancestors. So {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} let them be destroyed, and people are shocked at what happened to them, as you can see for yourselves.

es.L: Y no {{plural_you:sean|seáis}} como {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} padres y como {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} hermanos, que fueron infieles {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, el Dios de sus padres, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los entregó al horror, como {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{plural_you:ven|veis}}.
es.B: No {{plural_you:sean|seáis}} como {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} antepasados y {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} parientes, que fueron infieles {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, el Dios de sus antepasados, y por eso {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los convirtió en objeto de horror, como {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} mismos lo {{plural_you:ven|veis}}.
es.R: No {{plural_you:sean|seáis}} como {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} antepasados y {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} parientes. Ellos no fueron leales {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, el Dios de sus antepasados. Por eso {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} dejó que fueran destruidos, y la gente se espanta de lo que les pasó, como {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} mismos lo {{plural_you:pueden|podéis}} ver.

fr.L: Et ne soyez pas comme vos pères et comme vos frères, qui ont été infidèles envers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu de leurs pères, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a livrés à la désolation, comme vous le voyez.
fr.B: Ne soyez pas comme vos ancêtres et vos {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}, qui ont été infidèles {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, le Dieu de leurs ancêtres, si bien qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} en a fait un objet d’horreur, comme vous le voyez vous-mêmes.
fr.R: Ne soyez pas comme vos ancêtres et vos {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}}. Ils n’ont pas été fidèles {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, le Dieu de leurs ancêtres. Alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a laissé détruire, et les gens sont horrifiés de ce qui leur est arrivé, comme vous le voyez vous-mêmes.

sw.L: Wala msiwe kama baba zenu na kama ndugu zenu, waliokosa uaminifu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wa baba zao, naye akawatoa kuwa kitisho, kama mnavyoona.
sw.B: Msiwe kama babu zenu na ndugu zenu, ambao hawakuwa waaminifu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa babu zao, hata akawafanya kuwa kitu cha kutisha, kama mnavyoona wenyewe.
sw.R: Msiwe kama babu zenu na ndugu zenu. Hawakuwa waaminifu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa babu zao. Kwa hiyo aliwaacha waangamizwe, na watu wanashtuka kwa yaliyowapata, kama mnavyoona wenyewe.

vi.L: Đừng như tổ phụ các ngươi và như anh em các ngươi, là những người đã bất trung với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tổ phụ họ, nên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phó họ cho sự kinh hoàng, như các ngươi thấy đó.
vi.B: Đừng như tổ tiên và bà con anh em, là những người đã bất trung với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tổ tiên họ, đến nỗi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm cho họ thành điều kinh hoàng, như chính anh em thấy.
vi.R: Đừng như tổ tiên và bà con của anh em. Họ đã không trung thành với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tổ tiên họ. Vì vậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} để họ bị hủy diệt, và người ta kinh hoàng về những gì đã xảy ra cho họ, như chính anh em thấy.

ko.L: 그리고 너희 조상들과 너희 형제들처럼 되지 마라. 그들은 그들의 조상들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 신의를 저버렸고, 그분께서 그들을 놀람거리로 넘기셨다. 너희가 보는 대로다.
ko.B: 너희 조상들과 너희 친족들처럼 되지 마라. 그들은 조상들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 신의를 저버렸고, 그래서 그분께서 그들을 놀람거리가 되게 하셨다. 너희가 직접 보는 그대로다.
ko.R: 너희 조상들과 너희 친족들처럼 되지 마라. 그들은 조상들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 신실하지 못했다. 그래서 그분께서는 그들이 망하게 하셨고, 사람들은 그들에게 일어난 일을 보고 놀랐다. 너희가 직접 보는 그대로다.

pt.L: E não sejam como os seus pais e como os seus irmãos, que agiram com infidelidade contra {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus dos seus pais, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os entregou ao horror, como vocês estão vendo.
pt.B: Não sejam como os seus antepassados e os seus {{gender:parentes|irmãos}}, que foram infiéis {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o Deus dos seus antepassados, de modo que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez deles um objeto de horror, como vocês mesmos estão vendo.
pt.R: Não sejam como os seus antepassados e os seus {{gender:parentes|irmãos}}. Eles não foram fiéis {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o Deus dos antepassados deles. Por isso {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} deixou que fossem destruídos, e quem vê o que aconteceu com eles fica horrorizado, como vocês mesmos podem ver.

decisions.choice: acted unfaithfully: broke faith with Yahweh
decisions.reason: The verb means to betray a trust, to take what belongs to another. Chronicles uses it for the sin that brought disaster on Saul (1 Chronicles 10:13), on Ahaz (28:19, 22) and on the generation before Hezekiah (29:6).

decisions.choice: gave them up to horror: made them a ruin that appalled those who saw it
decisions.reason: The word means desolation and the horror people feel at the sight of it. Hezekiah used it of Judah's own losses in 29:8; Jeremiah uses it of the land after the exile (Jeremiah 25:9, 18).

decisions.choice: your brothers: the fellow Israelites already taken away
decisions.reason: "Your brothers" are the people of the northern tribes who had been carried off by Assyria (verse 6, verse 9). The word means kin, not only male relatives.

decisions.choice: ancestors (Balanced, Readable); relatives (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "fathers" and "brothers". Balanced and Readable say "ancestors" and "relatives", with "brothers" as the alternative wording. Readable spells out "object of horror" as what happened and how people reacted.

decisions.choice: "frères et sœurs" / "frères"
decisions.reason: The fellow Israelites already taken away were men and women; the inclusive default names both, with the Hebrew's "brothers" as the alternative, as the English gives "relatives" / "brothers".

decisions.choice: "bà con" with no gender span
decisions.reason: "Bà con" (relatives) already includes men and women, so Vietnamese has one wording where the English offers "relatives" or "brothers"; Literal keeps "anh em".

decisions.choice: "친족들" for "brothers", with no gender span
decisions.reason: "친족" already means kin of either sex, so Korean has no second wording to offer (m3); the same holds for "자녀" in verse 9.

decisions.choice: {{gender:parentes|irmãos}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: The fellow Israelites already taken away (m3) are "parentes" by default at Balanced and Readable, as the English "relatives", with the traditional "irmãos" as the alternative; Literal keeps "irmãos". "Agir com infidelidade" (L) and "ser infiel" (B) render the verb of breaking faith (m1).

source.text: עַתָּ֕ה אַל־תַּקְשׁ֥וּ עָרְפְּכֶ֖ם כַּאֲבוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם תְּנוּ־יָ֣ד לַיהוָ֗ה וּבֹ֤אוּ לְמִקְדָּשׁוֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִקְדִּ֣ישׁ לְעוֹלָ֔ם וְעִבְדוּ֙ אֶת־יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֔ם וְיָשֹׁ֥ב מִכֶּ֖ם חֲר֥וֹן אַפּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Now not stiffen your neck like your fathers; give [a] hand to Yahweh and come to his sanctuary which he consecrated forever, and serve Yahweh your God, and will turn from you [the] burning of his anger.

en.L: Now do not stiffen your neck like your fathers; give a hand to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and come to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} sanctuary, which {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has consecrated forever, and serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, so that the burning of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anger may turn from you.
en.B: Now do not stiffen your necks as your ancestors did. Give yourselves to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and come to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} sanctuary, which {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has made holy forever. Serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, so that {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} burning anger may turn away from you.
en.R: Do not be stubborn, as your ancestors were. Submit to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Come to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} temple, which {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has made holy forever. Serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, and then {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} fierce anger will turn away from you.

es.L: Ahora no {{plural_you:endurezcan|endurezcáis}} {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} cerviz como {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} padres; {{plural_you:den|dad}} la mano {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y {{plural_you:vengan|venid}} a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santuario, que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha santificado para siempre, y {{plural_you:sirvan|servid}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Dios, para que el ardor de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ira se aparte de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.B: Ahora no {{plural_you:endurezcan|endurezcáis}} la cerviz como lo hicieron {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} antepasados. {{plural_you:Entréguense|Entregaos}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y {{plural_you:vengan|venid}} a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santuario, que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha santificado para siempre. {{plural_you:Sirvan|Servid}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Dios, para que el ardor de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ira se aparte de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.
es.R: No {{plural_you:sean|seáis}} tercos como lo fueron {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} antepasados. {{plural_you:Sométanse|Someteos}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. {{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}} a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} templo, que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha hecho santo para siempre. {{plural_you:Sirvan|Servid}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Dios, y entonces {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ira se apartará de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.

fr.L: Maintenant, ne raidissez pas votre nuque comme vos pères ; donnez la main {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} et venez à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} sanctuaire, qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a consacré pour toujours, et servez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu, afin que l’ardeur de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère se détourne de vous.
fr.B: Maintenant, ne raidissez pas votre nuque comme vos ancêtres. Donnez-vous {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} et venez à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} sanctuaire, qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a consacré pour toujours. Servez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu, afin que {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère ardente se détourne de vous.
fr.R: Ne soyez pas têtus comme vos ancêtres. Soumettez-vous {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. Venez à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} temple, qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a rendu saint pour toujours. Servez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu, et alors {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} terrible colère se détournera de vous.

sw.L: Sasa msifanye shingo zenu kuwa ngumu kama baba zenu; mpeni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} mkono, mkaje patakatifu {{deity_pronoun:pake|Pake}}, alipopatakasa milele, mkamtumikie {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu, ili ukali wa hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} ugeuke mbali nanyi.
sw.B: Sasa msifanye shingo zenu kuwa ngumu kama babu zenu walivyofanya. Jitoeni kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mje patakatifu {{deity_pronoun:pake|Pake}}, alipopafanya kuwa patakatifu milele. Mtumikieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu, ili hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kali igeuke mbali nanyi.
sw.R: Msiwe wakaidi kama babu zenu walivyokuwa. Mtiini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Njooni kwenye hekalu {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, alilolifanya kuwa takatifu milele. Mtumikieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu, ndipo hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kali itageuka mbali nanyi.

vi.L: Bây giờ đừng cứng cổ như tổ phụ các ngươi; hãy đưa tay cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và đến nơi thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã thánh hóa đời đời, và hãy phục vụ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi, để cơn giận phừng phừng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} quay khỏi các ngươi.
vi.B: Bây giờ đừng cứng cổ như tổ tiên anh em. Hãy quy phục {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và đến nơi thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã thánh hóa đời đời. Hãy phục vụ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của anh em, để cơn giận phừng phừng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} quay khỏi anh em.
vi.R: Đừng cứng đầu như tổ tiên anh em. Hãy vâng phục {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Hãy đến đền thờ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm nên thánh đời đời. Hãy phục vụ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của anh em, thì cơn giận dữ dội của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ quay khỏi anh em.

ko.L: 이제 너희 조상들처럼 너희 목을 곧게 하지 마라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 손을 내밀고, 그분께서 영원히 거룩하게 하신 그분의 성소로 오너라. 그리고 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 섬겨라. 그러면 그분의 맹렬한 진노가 너희에게서 떠날 것이다.
ko.B: 이제 너희 조상들처럼 목을 곧게 하지 마라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 너희 자신을 맡기고, 그분께서 영원히 거룩하게 하신 그분의 성소로 오너라. 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 섬겨라. 그러면 그분의 맹렬한 진노가 너희에게서 떠날 것이다.
ko.R: 너희 조상들처럼 고집을 부리지 마라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 순종하여라. 그분께서 영원히 거룩하게 하신 그분의 성전으로 오너라. 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 섬겨라. 그러면 그분께서 너희에게 더 이상 진노하지 않으실 것이다.

pt.L: Agora não endureçam a sua cerviz como os seus pais; deem a mão {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} e venham ao {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} santuário, que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} consagrou para sempre, e sirvam {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o seu Deus, para que o ardor da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} ira se afaste de vocês.
pt.B: Agora não endureçam a cerviz, como fizeram os seus antepassados. Entreguem-se {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} e venham ao {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} santuário, que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} consagrou para sempre. Sirvam {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o seu Deus, para que a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} ira ardente se afaste de vocês.
pt.R: Não sejam teimosos, como os seus antepassados foram. Submetam-se {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}. Venham ao templo {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}, que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} tornou santo para sempre. Sirvam {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, e então a ira terrível {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} vai se afastar de vocês.

decisions.choice: do not stiffen your neck: do not refuse to obey
decisions.reason: The picture is of an ox that stiffens its neck against the yoke. The same words describe the northern kingdom's refusal to listen in 2 Kings 17:14, "they stiffened their neck like the neck of their fathers"; here the north is urged not to repeat it.

decisions.choice: give a hand to Yahweh: pledge yourselves to him
decisions.reason: To give one's hand was to make a pledge or to submit to someone, as the leaders gave their hand to Solomon (1 Chronicles 29:24) and the men of Ezra's day gave their hand to send away their foreign wives (Ezra 10:19).

decisions.choice: his sanctuary, which he has consecrated forever
decisions.reason: Yahweh had told Solomon that he had chosen and consecrated this house so that his name would be there forever (7:16). For northern Israelites, coming to Jerusalem meant leaving the shrines set up by Jeroboam (11:14-15; 13:8-9).

decisions.choice: so that his burning anger may turn from you
decisions.reason: Hezekiah used the same words of Judah in 29:10: the disasters of the past were signs of Yahweh's anger, and turning back to him would turn it away.

decisions.choice: stiffen your necks (Balanced); be stubborn (Readable); give yourselves to (Balanced); submit to (Readable)
decisions.reason: As at 2 Kings 17:14, Balanced keeps the picture of the neck and Readable says what it means. Balanced and Readable say what giving a hand means (m2) rather than keep the gesture. Readable says "temple" for "sanctuary".

decisions.choice: "no endurezcan la cerviz" (B); "no sean tercos" (R); "Entréguense" (B); "Sométanse" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Spanish 2 Kings 17:14, Balanced keeps the picture of the neck and Readable says what it means; Balanced and Readable give the sense of "give a hand" (m2).

decisions.choice: "손을 내밀고" for "give a hand" at Literal
decisions.reason: Korean "to hold out one's hand" carries a pledge of agreement as the Hebrew gesture does (m2); Balanced and Readable say what it means.

decisions.choice: endureçam a cerviz (L, B); não sejam teimosos (R)
decisions.reason: The words of 2 Kings 17:14 in Portuguese, which this verse echoes (m1): "endurecer a cerviz" at Literal and Balanced, "ser teimoso" at Readable. Literal keeps the gesture "deem a mão" (m2); Balanced and Readable say "entreguem-se" and "submetam-se", as the English.

decisions.choice: o templo dele, a ira terrível dele (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says "dele" because the speakers address the people as "vocês", and "o seu templo" could be read as "your temple".

source.text: כִּ֣י בְשׁוּבְכֶ֞ם עַל־יְהוָ֗ה אֲחֵיכֶ֨ם וּבְנֵיכֶ֤ם לְרַחֲמִים֙ לִפְנֵ֣י שֽׁוֹבֵיהֶ֔ם וְלָשׁ֖וּב לָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֑את כִּֽי־חַנּ֤וּן וְרַחוּם֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֔ם וְלֹא־יָסִ֤יר פָּנִים֙ מִכֶּ֔ם אִם־תָּשׁ֖וּבוּ אֵלָֽיו׃פ

records.literal_gloss: For in your returning to Yahweh, your brothers and your sons [will be] for compassion before their captors, and to return to the land the this; for gracious and compassionate [is] Yahweh your God, and not he will turn aside face from you if you return to him.

en.L: For when you return to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, your brothers and your sons [will find] compassion before their captors, and [will] return to this land; for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God [is] gracious and compassionate, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will not turn [{{deity_pronoun:his|His}}] face from you if you return to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}."
en.B: For if you return to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, your {{gender:relatives|brothers}} and your {{gender:children|sons}} will be shown compassion by those who took them captive, and they will come back to this land. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} your God is gracious and compassionate, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will not turn {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} face away from you if you turn back to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}."
en.R: If you come back to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the people who took your {{gender:relatives|brothers}} and {{gender:children|sons}} away as prisoners will treat them kindly, and they will be able to come home to this land. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} your God is kind and full of mercy. If you come back to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will not turn away from you."

es.L: Porque si {{plural_you:vuelven|volvéis}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} hermanos y {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} hijos [hallarán] compasión delante de sus captores, y [volverán] a esta tierra; porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Dios [es] clemente y compasivo, y no apartará [{{deity_pronoun:su|Su}}] rostro de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, si {{plural_you:se vuelven|os volvéis}} a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}».
es.B: Porque si {{plural_you:vuelven|volvéis}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, los que se llevaron cautivos a {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} parientes y a {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} hijos les tendrán compasión, y ellos volverán a esta tierra. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Dios es clemente y compasivo, y no apartará de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} rostro si {{plural_you:se vuelven|os volvéis}} a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}».
es.R: Si {{plural_you:vuelven|volvéis}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, los que se llevaron prisioneros a {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} parientes y a {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} hijos los tratarán con bondad, y ellos podrán volver a casa, a esta tierra. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Dios es bondadoso y lleno de misericordia. Si {{plural_you:vuelven|volvéis}} a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, no {{plural_you:los|os}} rechazará».

fr.L: Car quand vous reviendrez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, vos frères et vos fils [trouveront] compassion auprès de ceux qui les ont emmenés captifs, et [ils] reviendront dans ce pays ; car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu [est] miséricordieux et compatissant, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne détournera pas [{{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}}] face de vous si vous revenez à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. »
fr.B: Car si vous revenez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, vos {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} et vos {{gender:enfants|fils}} trouveront de la compassion auprès de ceux qui les ont emmenés captifs, et ils reviendront dans ce pays. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu est miséricordieux et compatissant, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne détournera pas de vous {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} visage si vous revenez à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. »
fr.R: Si vous revenez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, les gens qui ont emmené vos {{gender:frères et sœurs|frères}} et vos {{gender:enfants|fils}} comme prisonniers les traiteront avec bonté, et ils pourront rentrer dans ce pays. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu est bon et plein de pitié. Si vous revenez à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne se détournera pas de vous. »

sw.L: Kwa maana mkimrudia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ndugu zenu na wana wenu [watapata] huruma mbele ya wale waliowateka, na [watarudi] katika nchi hii; kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu [ni] mwenye neema na huruma, wala hatageuza uso [{{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}] mbali nanyi kama mkimrudia."
sw.B: Kwa maana mkimrudia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ndugu zenu na watoto wenu watahurumiwa na wale waliowachukua mateka, nao watarudi katika nchi hii. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu ni mwenye neema na huruma, wala hatageuza uso {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mbali nanyi mkimrudia."
sw.R: Mkimrudia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, watu waliowachukua ndugu zenu na watoto wenu kuwa wafungwa watawatendea kwa wema, nao wataweza kurudi nyumbani katika nchi hii. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu ni mwema na amejaa rehema. Mkimrudia, hatawageuzia mgongo."

vi.L: Vì khi các ngươi trở lại với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, anh em và con cái các ngươi [sẽ được] thương xót trước mặt những kẻ bắt họ, và [sẽ] trở về xứ này; vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi, [là] Đấng nhân từ và thương xót, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ không ngoảnh mặt khỏi các ngươi nếu các ngươi trở lại với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}."
vi.B: Vì nếu anh em trở lại với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, thì bà con và con cái anh em sẽ được những kẻ bắt họ thương xót, và họ sẽ trở về xứ này. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của anh em, là Đấng nhân từ và thương xót, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ không ngoảnh mặt khỏi anh em nếu anh em quay về với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}."
vi.R: Nếu anh em trở về với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, những kẻ đã bắt bà con và con cái anh em đi sẽ đối xử tử tế với họ, và họ sẽ được trở về xứ này. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của anh em, là Đấng tốt lành và đầy lòng thương xót. Nếu anh em trở về với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ không quay mặt khỏi anh em."

ko.L: 너희가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 돌아오면, 너희 형제들과 너희 아들들이 그들을 사로잡아 간 자들 앞에서 긍휼을 [얻고], 이 땅으로 돌아올 것이다. 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 은혜로우시고 자비로우셔서, 너희가 그분께 돌아오면 너희에게서 얼굴을 돌리지 않으실 것이다."
ko.B: 너희가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 돌아오면, 너희 친족들과 자녀들이 그들을 사로잡아 간 자들에게 긍휼을 입어 이 땅으로 돌아올 것이다. 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 은혜로우시고 자비가 많으시다. 너희가 그분께 돌아오면 그분께서 너희에게서 얼굴을 돌리지 않으실 것이다."
ko.R: 너희가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 돌아오면, 너희 친족들과 자녀들을 포로로 잡아간 사람들이 그들을 너그럽게 대해 줄 것이다. 그래서 그들이 이 땅으로 돌아올 수 있을 것이다. 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 친절하시고 자비가 넘치신다. 너희가 그분께 돌아오면 그분께서 너희를 외면하지 않으실 것이다."

pt.L: Porque, quando vocês voltarem para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, os seus irmãos e os seus filhos [acharão] compaixão diante dos que os levaram cativos, e [poderão] voltar para esta terra; porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o seu Deus, [é] misericordioso e compassivo, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} não desviará [o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}}] rosto de vocês, se vocês voltarem para {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}."
pt.B: Pois, se vocês voltarem para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, os seus {{gender:parentes|irmãos}} e os seus filhos encontrarão compaixão da parte dos que os levaram cativos e voltarão para esta terra. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}}, o seu Deus, é misericordioso e compassivo, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} não desviará de vocês o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} rosto, se vocês se voltarem para {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}."
pt.R: Se vocês voltarem para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, as pessoas que levaram os seus {{gender:parentes|irmãos}} e os seus filhos como prisioneiros vão tratá-los com bondade, e eles vão poder voltar para casa, para esta terra. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, é bondoso e cheio de compaixão. Se vocês voltarem para {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} não vai dar as costas a vocês."

decisions.choice: compassion before their captors: as Solomon prayed
decisions.reason: Solomon asked Yahweh to forgive his people when they were taken captive and to "give them compassion before their captors" (1 Kings 8:50; compare 2 Chronicles 6:36-39). The couriers promise that prayer will be answered if the people return.

decisions.choice: gracious and compassionate is Yahweh your God
decisions.reason: These are the first words of Yahweh's description of himself to Moses, "a God compassionate and gracious" (Exodus 34:6). Here, as in Psalm 111:4, Joel 2:13, Jonah 4:2 and Nehemiah 9:17, the two words come in the other order, "gracious and compassionate"; the meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: he will not turn his face from you: he will not reject you
decisions.reason: To turn one's face away is to refuse favor or help; Solomon prayed "do not turn away the face of your anointed" (6:42). Yahweh will receive those who come back.

decisions.choice: your brothers and your sons: family members in exile
decisions.reason: The words mean the people's relatives and children, men and women, who had been carried away (verse 6). Their return depends on the people's own return to Yahweh.

decisions.choice: gracious and compassionate (Literal, Balanced); kind and full of mercy (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep two words close to those of Exodus 34:6. Readable uses plainer words with the same sense, close to its wording at Exodus 34:6. Balanced and Readable give "relatives" and "children", with "brothers" and "sons" as the alternative wording, and Readable turns the captors into the subject of its sentence.

decisions.choice: "clemente y compasivo" (L, B); "bondadoso y lleno de misericordia" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep two words close to those of the published Spanish of Exodus 34:6; Readable uses plainer words, as the English does.

decisions.choice: mwenye neema na huruma
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep two words close to the Swahili of Exodus 34:6 (m2); Readable says "mwema na amejaa rehema".

decisions.choice: "은혜로우시고 자비로우시다" (Literal), "은혜로우시고 자비가 많으시다" (Balanced), "친절하시고 자비가 넘치신다" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording of the published Korean Psalm 111:4, which has the same two words in the same order (m2).

decisions.choice: misericordioso e compassivo (L, B); bondoso e cheio de compaixão (R)
decisions.reason: The two words of Exodus 34:6 in Portuguese, "compassivo" for the tender love and "misericordioso" for grace (m2), here in the order of this verse, as the English keeps it; Readable keeps "compaixão", as Exodus 34:6 does at Readable. "Compaixão diante dos que os levaram cativos" (L) is the wording of 1 Kings 8:50 in Portuguese (m1); Readable's "dar as costas" is that of 6:42.

decisions.choice: {{gender:parentes|irmãos}}; os seus filhos, with no gender span
decisions.reason: As in verse 7 for the relatives; "filhos" already includes daughters (m4), so it needs no setting where the English has "children|sons".

source.text: וַיִּֽהְי֨וּ הָרָצִ֜ים עֹבְרִ֨ים מֵעִ֧יר׀לָעִ֛יר בְּאֶֽרֶץ־אֶפְרַ֥יִם וּמְנַשֶּׁ֖ה וְעַד־זְבֻל֑וּן וַיִּֽהְיוּ֙ מַשְׂחִיקִ֣ים עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וּמַלְעִגִ֖ים בָּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And were the runners passing from city to city in [the] land of Ephraim and Manasseh and as far as Zebulun, and they were laughing at them and mocking them.

en.L: And the runners were passing from city to city in the land of Ephraim and Manasseh, and as far as Zebulun; but they were laughing at them and mocking them.
en.B: The couriers passed from town to town in the land of Ephraim and Manasseh and on as far as Zebulun, but people laughed at them and mocked them.
en.R: The messengers went from town to town in the land of Ephraim and Manasseh, and as far north as Zebulun. But the people there laughed at them and made fun of them.

es.L: Y los correos pasaban de ciudad en ciudad por la tierra de Efraín y Manasés, y hasta Zabulón; pero se reían de ellos y se burlaban de ellos.
es.B: Los correos pasaron de ciudad en ciudad por la tierra de Efraín y Manasés, y hasta Zabulón, pero la gente se reía de ellos y se burlaba de ellos.
es.R: Los mensajeros fueron de pueblo en pueblo por la tierra de Efraín y Manasés, y hasta Zabulón, en el norte. Pero la gente de allí se reía de ellos y se burlaba de ellos.

fr.L: Et les coureurs passaient de ville en ville dans le pays d’Éphraïm et de Manassé, et jusqu’à Zabulon ; mais on se moquait d’eux et on les tournait en ridicule.
fr.B: Les courriers passèrent de ville en ville dans le pays d’Éphraïm et de Manassé, et jusqu’à Zabulon, mais les gens se moquaient d’eux et les tournaient en ridicule.
fr.R: Les messagers sont allés de ville en ville dans le pays d’Éphraïm et de Manassé, et jusqu’à Zabulon, plus au nord. Mais les gens de là-bas se moquaient d’eux et riaient d’eux.

sw.L: Wakimbiaji wakapita mji kwa mji katika nchi ya Efraimu na Manase, hata Zabuloni; lakini wakawacheka na kuwadhihaki.
sw.B: Wajumbe walipita mji kwa mji katika nchi ya Efraimu na Manase, hata Zabuloni, lakini watu waliwacheka na kuwadhihaki.
sw.R: Wajumbe walikwenda mji kwa mji katika nchi ya Efraimu na Manase, na kaskazini hadi Zabuloni. Lakini watu wa huko waliwacheka na kuwadhihaki.

vi.L: Các người chạy thư đi từ thành này sang thành khác trong xứ Ép-ra-im và Ma-na-se, đến tận Sa-bu-lôn; nhưng người ta cười nhạo và chế giễu họ.
vi.B: Các người đưa thư đi từ thành này sang thành khác trong xứ Ép-ra-im và Ma-na-se, cho đến tận Sa-bu-lôn, nhưng người ta cười nhạo và chế giễu họ.
vi.R: Những người đưa tin đi từ thành này sang thành khác trong xứ Ép-ra-im và Ma-na-se, và lên tận Sa-bu-lôn ở phía bắc. Nhưng dân ở đó cười nhạo và chế giễu họ.

ko.L: 그리고 달리는 자들이 에브라임과 므낫세 땅에서 성읍에서 성읍으로, 스불론까지 두루 다녔다. 그러나 사람들이 그들을 비웃고 조롱했다.
ko.B: 전령들이 에브라임과 므낫세 땅의 성읍들을 차례로 다니며 스불론까지 갔으나, 사람들은 그들을 비웃고 조롱했다.
ko.R: 전령들은 에브라임과 므낫세 땅의 성읍들을 하나하나 다니며 북쪽 스불론까지 갔다. 그러나 그곳 사람들은 그들을 비웃고 놀려 댔다.

pt.L: E os corredores estavam passando de cidade em cidade pela terra de Efraim e Manassés, e até Zebulom; mas riam deles e zombavam deles.
pt.B: Os mensageiros passaram de cidade em cidade pela terra de Efraim e de Manassés, até Zebulom, mas o povo ria deles e zombava deles.
pt.R: Os mensageiros foram de cidade em cidade na terra de Efraim e de Manassés e chegaram até Zebulom, mais ao norte. Mas o povo de lá ria deles e caçoava deles.

decisions.choice: as far as Zebulun: into Galilee in the far north
decisions.reason: Ephraim and Manasseh lay in the hill country north of Judah; Zebulun's land was further north, in Galilee. The couriers carried the letter through the whole of what had been the northern kingdom.

decisions.choice: laughing at them and mocking them
decisions.reason: Most of the north scorned the call. The same verb for mocking returns at the end of the book, where Judah itself mocks God's messengers until there is no remedy (36:16).

decisions.choice: people (Balanced); the people there (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "they were laughing". Balanced and Readable name the people of those towns as the subject, so the couriers are not taken as the ones laughing. Readable adds "north" to show where Zebulun lay.

decisions.choice: "달리는 자들" (Literal), "전령들" (Balanced, Readable) for the runners
decisions.reason: The Kings drafts use "호위병" for the runners as palace guards; here they carry the king's letters (m1 at verse 6), so Balanced and Readable say "messengers".

source.text: אַךְ־אֲנָשִׁ֛ים מֵאָשֵׁ֥ר וּמְנַשֶּׁ֖ה וּמִזְּבֻל֑וּן נִֽכְנְע֔וּ וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ לִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Only men from Asher and Manasseh and from Zebulun humbled themselves and came to Jerusalem.

en.L: Only men from Asher and Manasseh and from Zebulun humbled themselves and came to Jerusalem.
en.B: Yet some {{gender:people|men}} from Asher, Manasseh and Zebulun humbled themselves and came to Jerusalem.
en.R: But some {{gender:people|men}} from the tribes of Asher, Manasseh and Zebulun humbled themselves and came to Jerusalem.

es.L: Solo algunos hombres de Aser y de Manasés y de Zabulón se humillaron y vinieron a Jerusalén.
es.B: Sin embargo, algunos de Aser, de Manasés y de Zabulón se humillaron y vinieron a Jerusalén.
es.R: Pero algunos de las tribus de Aser, Manasés y Zabulón se humillaron y vinieron a Jerusalén.

fr.L: Seulement, des hommes d’Asher, et de Manassé, et de Zabulon s’humilièrent et vinrent à Jérusalem.
fr.B: Pourtant quelques {{gender:personnes|hommes}} d’Asher, de Manassé et de Zabulon s’humilièrent et vinrent à Jérusalem.
fr.R: Mais quelques {{gender:personnes|hommes}} des tribus d’Asher, de Manassé et de Zabulon se sont humiliés et sont venus à Jérusalem.

sw.L: Ila watu wa Asheri na Manase na wa Zabuloni walijinyenyekeza, wakaja Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Hata hivyo baadhi ya watu wa Asheri, Manase na Zabuloni walijinyenyekeza, wakaja Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Lakini baadhi ya watu wa makabila ya Asheri, Manase na Zabuloni walijinyenyekeza, wakaja Yerusalemu.

vi.L: Chỉ có những người từ A-se, Ma-na-se và Sa-bu-lôn hạ mình xuống và đến Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Tuy vậy, có một số người từ A-se, Ma-na-se và Sa-bu-lôn hạ mình và đến Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: Nhưng có một số người từ các chi tộc A-se, Ma-na-se và Sa-bu-lôn đã hạ mình và đến Giê-ru-sa-lem.

ko.L: 다만 아셀과 므낫세와 스불론에서 사람들이 겸손하게 낮추고 예루살렘으로 왔다.
ko.B: 그러나 아셀과 므낫세와 스불론에서 몇몇 사람은 스스로 겸손히 낮추고 예루살렘으로 왔다.
ko.R: 그러나 아셀 지파와 므낫세 지파와 스불론 지파에서 몇몇 사람은 겸손한 마음으로 예루살렘에 왔다.

pt.L: Somente homens de Aser, e de Manassés, e de Zebulom se humilharam e vieram a Jerusalém.
pt.B: Mesmo assim, {{gender:algumas pessoas|alguns homens}} de Aser, Manassés e Zebulom se humilharam e vieram a Jerusalém.
pt.R: Mas {{gender:algumas pessoas|alguns homens}} das tribos de Aser, Manassés e Zebulom se humilharam e foram a Jerusalém.

decisions.choice: only men from Asher ...: yet some did come
decisions.reason: The opening word sets these few against the many who mocked (verse 10). The word for men is the ordinary plural for people; verse 18 shows that whole families from the north ate the Passover.

decisions.choice: humbled themselves: turned from pride to Yahweh
decisions.reason: Humbling oneself is what Yahweh asked of his people in 7:14, and in Chronicles it is the turning point for kings and people alike (12:6-7, 12; 32:26; 33:12). These northerners did what the letter asked (verses 6-9).

decisions.choice: Yet some (Balanced); But some ... the tribes of (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "some" for the contrast in m1 and use an inclusive word for the group, with "men" as the alternative wording.

decisions.choice: "몇몇 사람" with no gender span
decisions.reason: "사람" covers men and women alike, so Korean has no second wording for the setting to offer.

decisions.choice: {{gender:algumas pessoas|alguns homens}}; se humilharam
decisions.reason: The span takes in "algumas/alguns", which must agree with the noun, as the English "some people|men" (m1). "Humilhar-se" is the verb 12:6-7 and 7:14 use in Portuguese (m2).

source.text: גַּ֣ם בִּיהוּדָ֗ה הָֽיְתָה֙ יַ֣ד הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים לָתֵ֥ת לָהֶ֖ם לֵ֣ב אֶחָ֑ד לַעֲשׂ֞וֹת מִצְוַ֥ת הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ וְהַשָּׂרִ֖ים בִּדְבַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Also in Judah was [the] hand of God to give to them heart one to do [the] command of the king and the princes by [the] word of Yahweh.

en.L: Also on Judah was the hand of God, to give them one heart to do the command of the king and the princes by the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: In Judah too the hand of God was at work, giving them one heart to carry out the command of the king and the officials, which followed the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: In Judah, too, God was at work. He made the people united in wanting to do what the king and his leaders had commanded, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had said.

es.L: También sobre Judá estuvo la mano de Dios, para darles un solo corazón para cumplir el mandato del rey y de los príncipes, conforme a la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: También en Judá actuó la mano de Dios, dándoles un solo corazón para cumplir el mandato del rey y de los jefes, que seguía la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: También en Judá Dios actuó. Hizo que la gente se uniera en el deseo de cumplir lo que el rey y sus dirigentes habían mandado, como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo había dicho.

fr.L: En Juda aussi fut la main de Dieu, pour leur donner un seul cœur afin d’exécuter l’ordre du roi et des princes, selon la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: En Juda aussi, la main de Dieu agit pour leur donner un même cœur, afin d’exécuter l’ordre du roi et des chefs, qui suivait la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: En Juda aussi, Dieu a agi. Il a uni le peuple dans le désir de faire ce que le roi et ses chefs avaient ordonné, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait dit.

sw.L: Tena katika Yuda mkono wa Mungu ulikuwa juu yao, kuwapa moyo mmoja wa kufanya amri ya mfalme na ya wakuu kwa neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Katika Yuda pia mkono wa Mungu ulikuwa ukifanya kazi, ukiwapa moyo mmoja wa kutekeleza amri ya mfalme na ya maafisa, iliyofuata neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Katika Yuda pia Mungu alikuwa akifanya kazi. Aliwaunganisha watu wakawa na nia moja ya kufanya yale ambayo mfalme na viongozi wake walikuwa wameamuru, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyosema.

vi.L: Tay của Đức Chúa Trời cũng ở trên Giu-đa, ban cho họ một lòng để làm theo lệnh của vua và các thủ lĩnh, theo lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Tại Giu-đa cũng vậy, tay Đức Chúa Trời hành động, ban cho họ một lòng một ý để thi hành lệnh của vua và các quan chức, là lệnh theo lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Tại Giu-đa cũng vậy, Đức Chúa Trời đang hành động. Ngài làm cho dân chúng đồng lòng muốn làm theo điều vua và các người lãnh đạo đã truyền, đúng như lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán.

ko.L: 또 유다에도 하나님의 손이 있어서, 그들에게 한마음을 주어 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀에 따라 왕과 지도자들이 명령한 것을 행하게 하셨다.
ko.B: 유다에서도 하나님의 손이 그들에게 함께하셔서, 그들에게 한마음을 주시고, 왕과 관리들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀에 따라 내린 명령을 행하게 하셨다.
ko.R: 유다에서도 하나님께서 일하셨다. 그분께서는 백성이 한마음이 되어, 왕과 지도자들이 명령한 것을 기꺼이 하게 하셨다. 그 명령은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하신 대로였다.

pt.L: Também sobre Judá esteve a mão de Deus, para lhes dar um só coração, para cumprirem a ordem do rei e dos príncipes, segundo a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: Também em Judá a mão de Deus estava agindo, dando-lhes um só coração para cumprirem a ordem do rei e dos oficiais, que seguia a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: Também em Judá Deus estava agindo. Ele fez o povo ficar unido no desejo de fazer o que o rei e os seus líderes tinham mandado, como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha dito.

decisions.choice: the hand of God: God's power at work
decisions.reason: The hand of God on a people or a person means his power acting for them, as in Ezra 7:9 and 8:18. Here it moves Judah to agree.

decisions.choice: one heart: a single, united will
