decisions.reason: To have one heart is to be of one mind and purpose, as the warriors who came to make David king were "of one heart" (1 Chronicles 12:39).

decisions.choice: the command of the king ... by the word of Yahweh
decisions.reason: The king's command was not his own idea only; it followed what Yahweh had commanded in his law, as the temple service Hezekiah restored was "by the word of Yahweh" (29:15, 25).

decisions.choice: was at work (Balanced); God was at work (Readable); the officials (Balanced); his leaders (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the picture of God's hand means (m1). Readable says "united in wanting" for "one heart". The word for the king's chief men follows the wording used in verse 2.

source.text: וַיֵּֽאָסְפ֤וּ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ עַם־רָ֔ב לַעֲשׂ֛וֹת אֶת־חַ֥ג הַמַּצּ֖וֹת בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִ֑י קָהָ֖ל לָרֹ֥ב מְאֹֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And gathered [at] Jerusalem people many to do the festival of the unleavened [bread] in the month the second, an assembly great very.

en.L: And many people gathered [at] Jerusalem to keep the festival of unleavened bread in the second month, a very great assembly.
en.B: A great crowd gathered in Jerusalem to keep the Festival of Unleavened Bread in the second month, a very large assembly.
en.R: A huge crowd of people gathered in Jerusalem in the second month to celebrate the Festival of Unleavened Bread. It was a very large gathering.

es.L: Y se reunió [en] Jerusalén mucha gente para celebrar la fiesta de los Panes sin Levadura en el mes segundo, una asamblea muy grande.
es.B: Una gran multitud se reunió en Jerusalén para celebrar la fiesta de los Panes sin Levadura en el mes segundo; fue una asamblea muy numerosa.
es.R: Una enorme multitud se reunió en Jerusalén en el mes segundo para celebrar la fiesta de los Panes sin Levadura. Fue una reunión muy grande.

fr.L: Et beaucoup de gens se rassemblèrent [à] Jérusalem pour célébrer la fête des pains sans levain au deuxième mois, une assemblée très nombreuse.
fr.B: Une grande foule se rassembla à Jérusalem pour célébrer la fête des Pains sans levain au deuxième mois ; ce fut une assemblée très nombreuse.
fr.R: Une énorme foule s’est rassemblée à Jérusalem au deuxième mois pour célébrer la fête des Pains sans levain. C’était un très grand rassemblement.

sw.L: Watu wengi wakakusanyika Yerusalemu ili kufanya sikukuu ya mikate isiyotiwa chachu katika mwezi wa pili, kusanyiko kubwa sana.
sw.B: Umati mkubwa ulikusanyika Yerusalemu ili kufanya Sikukuu ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu katika mwezi wa pili, kusanyiko kubwa sana.
sw.R: Umati mkubwa sana wa watu ulikusanyika Yerusalemu katika mwezi wa pili ili kusherehekea Sikukuu ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu. Lilikuwa kusanyiko kubwa sana.

vi.L: Rất đông người nhóm lại [tại] Giê-ru-sa-lem để giữ Lễ Bánh Không Men vào tháng thứ hai, một hội chúng rất lớn.
vi.B: Một đám đông lớn nhóm lại tại Giê-ru-sa-lem để giữ Lễ Bánh Không Men vào tháng thứ hai, thật là một hội chúng rất lớn.
vi.R: Một đám đông rất lớn tụ họp tại Giê-ru-sa-lem vào tháng thứ hai để mừng Lễ Bánh Không Men. Đó là một cuộc tụ họp rất đông người.

ko.L: 그리고 둘째 달에 무교절을 지키려고 많은 백성이 예루살렘에 모였으니, 매우 큰 회중이었다.
ko.B: 둘째 달에 무교절을 지키려고 많은 백성이 예루살렘에 모였다. 아주 큰 회중이었다.
ko.R: 둘째 달에 아주 많은 사람이 무교절을 지키려고 예루살렘에 모였다. 엄청나게 큰 모임이었다.

pt.L: E se reuniu em Jerusalém muito povo, para celebrar a festa dos Pães sem Fermento no segundo mês, uma assembleia muito grande.
pt.B: Uma grande multidão se reuniu em Jerusalém para celebrar a festa dos Pães sem Fermento no segundo mês; foi uma assembleia muito numerosa.
pt.R: Uma enorme multidão se reuniu em Jerusalém no segundo mês para celebrar a festa dos Pães sem Fermento. Era muita gente reunida.

decisions.choice: the festival of unleavened bread: the seven days of eating bread made without yeast
decisions.reason: The Passover on the fourteenth day was followed by seven days when no yeast was eaten (Exodus 12:15-20; Leviticus 23:5-8). Here the name covers the whole celebration, the Passover included (verse 15), as the two were kept together.

decisions.choice: a very great assembly: the crowd met as Israel's gathered assembly
decisions.reason: The word is the same "assembly" as in verses 2 and 4. The Passover of verse 5, which had not been kept "in multitude", is now kept by a great assembly.

decisions.choice: the Festival of Unleavened Bread (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable write the name of the feast with capitals, as at 8:13.

decisions.choice: "la fiesta de los Panes sin Levadura"
decisions.reason: The feast as the Pentateuch note names it, at every level.

decisions.choice: "무교절" for the festival of unleavened bread
decisions.reason: The usual Korean name of the feast, short enough for every level; Readable could explain it, but verse 21 already says it lasted seven days.

decisions.choice: a festa dos Pães sem Fermento (every level)
decisions.reason: The name the Old Testament terms and 8:13 give the feast in Portuguese (m1), with its capital at every level, since Portuguese names the feast where the English Literal writes it in lowercase.

source.text: וַיָּקֻ֕מוּ וַיָּסִ֨ירוּ֙ אֶת־הַֽמִּזְבְּח֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֖ר בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְאֵ֤ת כָּל־הַֽמְקַטְּרוֹת֙ הֵסִ֔ירוּ וַיַּשְׁלִ֖יכוּ לְנַ֥חַל קִדְרֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: And they arose and removed the altars which [were] in Jerusalem, and all the incense altars they removed and threw [them] into [the] wadi of Kidron.

en.L: And they arose and removed the altars that [were] in Jerusalem, and all the incense altars they removed, and they threw [them] into the Wadi Kidron.
en.B: They set to work and removed the altars in Jerusalem. They also removed all the incense altars and threw them into the Kidron Valley.
en.R: The people went to work and took away the altars in Jerusalem. They also removed all the altars for burning incense and threw them into the Kidron Valley.

es.L: Y se levantaron y quitaron los altares que [había] en Jerusalén, y quitaron todos los altares de incienso y [los] arrojaron al torrente del Cedrón.
es.B: Se pusieron a trabajar y quitaron los altares que había en Jerusalén. Quitaron también todos los altares de incienso y los arrojaron al valle del Cedrón.
es.R: La gente se puso a trabajar y quitó los altares que había en Jerusalén. También quitaron todos los altares para quemar incienso y los arrojaron al valle del Cedrón.

fr.L: Et ils se levèrent et enlevèrent les autels qui [étaient] à Jérusalem, et tous les autels à encens, ils les enlevèrent, et ils [les] jetèrent dans le torrent du Cédron.
fr.B: Ils se mirent à l’œuvre et enlevèrent les autels qui étaient à Jérusalem. Ils enlevèrent aussi tous les autels à encens et les jetèrent dans la vallée du Cédron.
fr.R: Les gens se sont mis au travail et ils ont enlevé les autels qui se trouvaient à Jérusalem. Ils ont aussi enlevé tous les autels où l’on brûlait de l’encens, et ils les ont jetés dans la vallée du Cédron.

sw.L: Wakainuka, wakaziondoa madhabahu zilizokuwa katika Yerusalemu, na madhabahu zote za uvumba wakaziondoa, wakazitupa katika bonde la Kidroni.
sw.B: Waliianza kazi, wakaziondoa madhabahu zilizokuwa Yerusalemu. Wakaziondoa pia madhabahu zote za uvumba, wakazitupa katika Bonde la Kidroni.
sw.R: Watu walianza kazi, wakaziondoa madhabahu zilizokuwa Yerusalemu. Waliziondoa pia madhabahu zote za kufukizia uvumba, wakazitupa katika Bonde la Kidroni.

vi.L: Họ đứng dậy dẹp bỏ các bàn thờ ở Giê-ru-sa-lem; họ dẹp bỏ tất cả các bàn thờ xông hương và ném [chúng] xuống khe Xết-rôn.
vi.B: Họ bắt tay vào việc dẹp bỏ các bàn thờ ở Giê-ru-sa-lem. Họ cũng dẹp bỏ tất cả các bàn thờ xông hương và ném xuống thung lũng Xết-rôn.
vi.R: Dân chúng bắt tay vào việc dỡ bỏ các bàn thờ ở Giê-ru-sa-lem. Họ cũng dỡ bỏ tất cả các bàn thờ dùng để đốt hương và ném xuống thung lũng Xết-rôn.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 일어나 예루살렘에 있던 제단들을 없애고, 분향단들도 모두 없애서 기드론 시내에 던졌다.
ko.B: 그들은 일어나 예루살렘에 있던 제단들을 없앴다. 분향단들도 모두 없애서 기드론 골짜기에 던져 버렸다.
ko.R: 백성은 일을 시작하여 예루살렘에 있던 제단들을 치웠다. 향을 피우던 제단들도 모두 치워서 기드론 골짜기에 던져 버렸다.

pt.L: E se levantaram e removeram os altares que [havia] em Jerusalém, e removeram todos os altares de incenso e [os] lançaram no vale do Cedrom.
pt.B: Eles se puseram a trabalhar e tiraram os altares que havia em Jerusalém. Removeram também todos os altares de incenso e os jogaram no vale do Cedrom.
pt.R: As pessoas começaram o trabalho e tiraram os altares que havia em Jerusalém. Também tiraram todos os altares usados para queimar incenso e os jogaram no vale do Cedrom.

decisions.choice: the altars in Jerusalem and the incense altars: those set up by Ahaz
decisions.reason: Hezekiah's father Ahaz had made altars for himself in every corner of Jerusalem and high places in every town of Judah to burn incense to other gods (28:24-25). Before the feast the people cleared them away.

decisions.choice: the Wadi Kidron: the valley on the east side of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: A wadi is a valley with a stream that runs in the rainy season. The Kidron was where unclean things were thrown out and destroyed: Asa burned his mother's idol there (15:16), and the Levites carried the filth of the temple there (29:16).

decisions.choice: they arose: they set to work
decisions.reason: "Arose" here marks the start of an action, not standing up.

decisions.choice: the Wadi Kidron (Literal); the Kidron Valley (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As at 15:16. Readable says "altars for burning incense" so the word is clear.

decisions.choice: o vale do Cedrom (every level)
decisions.reason: As 15:16 in Portuguese, which says "o vale do Cedrom" at every level (m2); Portuguese has no common word for a wadi, so Literal does not keep the English Literal's "Wadi".

source.text: וַיִּשְׁחֲט֣וּ הַפֶּ֔סַח בְּאַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִ֑י וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֨ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֤ם נִכְלְמוּ֙ וַיִּֽתְקַדְּשׁ֔וּ וַיָּבִ֥יאוּ עֹל֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And they slaughtered the Passover on [the] fourteen of the month the second, and the priests and the Levites were ashamed and consecrated themselves and brought burnt offerings [to the] house of Yahweh.

en.L: And they slaughtered the Passover on the fourteenth [day] of the second month. And the priests and the Levites were ashamed, and they consecrated themselves and brought burnt offerings [into] the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: They slaughtered the Passover lamb on the fourteenth day of the second month. Ashamed, the priests and the Levites consecrated themselves and brought burnt offerings into the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: On the fourteenth day of the second month they killed the lambs for the Passover. The priests and Levites felt ashamed, so they made themselves holy and brought burnt offerings to the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y degollaron la Pascua el día catorce del mes segundo. Y los sacerdotes y los levitas se avergonzaron, y se santificaron, y trajeron holocaustos [a] la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Degollaron el cordero de la Pascua el día catorce del mes segundo. Los sacerdotes y los levitas, avergonzados, se santificaron y trajeron holocaustos a la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: El día catorce del mes segundo mataron los corderos para la Pascua. Los sacerdotes y los levitas sintieron vergüenza, así que se purificaron y llevaron holocaustos al templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et ils égorgèrent la Pâque le quatorzième [jour] du deuxième mois. Et les prêtres et les Lévites eurent honte, et ils se consacrèrent et apportèrent des holocaustes [dans] la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Ils égorgèrent l’agneau de la Pâque le quatorzième jour du deuxième mois. Pleins de honte, les prêtres et les Lévites se consacrèrent et apportèrent des holocaustes dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Le quatorzième jour du deuxième mois, ils ont tué les agneaux de la Pâque. Les prêtres et les Lévites ont eu honte, alors ils se sont rendus saints et ils ont apporté des holocaustes au temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Wakachinja Pasaka siku ya kumi na nne ya mwezi wa pili. Nao makuhani na Walawi wakaona aibu, wakajitakasa, wakaleta sadaka za kuteketezwa [ndani ya] nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Walimchinja mwana-kondoo wa Pasaka siku ya kumi na nne ya mwezi wa pili. Makuhani na Walawi, wakiwa wameona aibu, walijitakasa, wakaleta sadaka za kuteketezwa katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Siku ya kumi na nne ya mwezi wa pili waliwachinja wana-kondoo wa Pasaka. Makuhani na Walawi waliona aibu, kwa hiyo wakajifanya kuwa watakatifu, wakaleta sadaka za kuteketezwa katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Họ giết [chiên] Lễ Vượt Qua vào ngày mười bốn tháng thứ hai. Các thầy tế lễ và người Lê-vi hổ thẹn, nên thánh hóa chính mình và đem của lễ thiêu [vào] nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Họ giết chiên Lễ Vượt Qua vào ngày mười bốn tháng thứ hai. Các thầy tế lễ và người Lê-vi hổ thẹn, nên thánh hóa chính mình và đem của lễ thiêu vào nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Vào ngày mười bốn tháng thứ hai, họ giết chiên con để mừng Lễ Vượt Qua. Các thầy tế lễ và người Lê-vi cảm thấy xấu hổ, nên họ làm cho mình nên thánh và đem của lễ thiêu đến đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 둘째 달 열나흗날에 유월절 [양을] 잡았다. 그리고 제사장들과 레위인들이 부끄러워하여 자신을 거룩하게 하고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 번제물을 가져왔다.
ko.B: 그들은 둘째 달 열나흗날에 유월절 양을 잡았다. 제사장들과 레위인들은 부끄러워서 자신을 거룩하게 하고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 번제물을 가져왔다.
ko.R: 둘째 달 열나흗날에 그들은 유월절 양을 잡았다. 제사장들과 레위인들은 부끄러운 마음이 들어서, 자신을 거룩하게 하고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에 번제물을 가져왔다.

pt.L: E abateram a Páscoa no décimo quarto [dia] do segundo mês; e os sacerdotes e os levitas se envergonharam, e se consagraram, e trouxeram holocaustos [para] a casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: Abateram o cordeiro da Páscoa no décimo quarto dia do segundo mês. Envergonhados, os sacerdotes e os levitas se consagraram e trouxeram holocaustos à casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: No décimo quarto dia do segundo mês, eles mataram os cordeiros da Páscoa. Os sacerdotes e os levitas ficaram envergonhados. Por isso se santificaram e trouxeram holocaustos ao templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.

decisions.choice: the Passover: the Passover animal
decisions.reason: "The Passover" can name the animal killed for the feast, as in Exodus 12:21, "slaughter the Passover". It was a lamb or a young goat (Exodus 12:5).

decisions.choice: the priests and the Levites were ashamed: put to shame by the people's readiness
decisions.reason: The chapter does not say why. The most likely reason is that the people came eagerly while too few priests had made themselves ready (verse 3; 29:34). Their shame moved them to consecrate themselves at once.

decisions.choice: burnt offerings: the offerings the law required on each day of the feast
decisions.reason: Numbers 28:16-25 lists burnt offerings for every day of the Festival of Unleavened Bread. Once consecrated, the priests and Levites could present them.

decisions.choice: the Passover lamb (Balanced); the lambs for the Passover (Readable); made themselves holy (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the animal (m1). Readable says "made themselves holy" for "consecrated themselves", as at 5:11, and "temple" for "house".

decisions.choice: abateram a Páscoa (L); abateram o cordeiro da Páscoa (B); mataram os cordeiros da Páscoa (R)
decisions.reason: The words of Exodus 12:21 in Portuguese, the verse the meaning note cites for "slaughter the Passover" (m1): Literal keeps "a Páscoa" for the animal, Balanced names the lamb, and Readable says "matar", as there.

source.text: וַיַּֽעַמְד֤וּ עַל־עָמְדָם֙ כְּמִשְׁפָּטָ֔ם כְּתוֹרַ֖ת מֹשֶׁ֣ה אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ זֹרְקִ֣ים אֶת־הַדָּ֔ם מִיַּ֖ד הַלְוִיִּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And they stood at their place according to their ordinance, according to [the] law of Moses [the] man of God; the priests [were] throwing the blood from [the] hand of the Levites.

en.L: And they stood at their station according to their ordinance, according to the law of Moses the man of God; the priests [were] throwing the blood [received] from the hand of the Levites.
en.B: They took their usual places as the law of Moses the man of God prescribes, and the priests splashed the blood that they received from the Levites.
en.R: They stood in their places, as the law of Moses, the man of God, required. The Levites handed the blood to the priests, and the priests splashed it on the altar.

es.L: Y se pusieron en su puesto según su ordenanza, conforme a la ley de Moisés, hombre de Dios; los sacerdotes rociaban la sangre [recibida] de mano de los levitas.
es.B: Ocuparon sus puestos de costumbre, como lo manda la ley de Moisés, hombre de Dios, y los sacerdotes rociaban la sangre que recibían de los levitas.
es.R: Se pusieron en sus puestos, como lo mandaba la ley de Moisés, el hombre de Dios. Los levitas les pasaban la sangre a los sacerdotes, y los sacerdotes la rociaban sobre el altar.

fr.L: Et ils se tinrent à leur place selon leur règle, selon la loi de Moïse, l’homme de Dieu ; les prêtres répandaient le sang [qu’ils recevaient] de la main des Lévites.
fr.B: Ils prirent leurs places habituelles, comme le prescrit la loi de Moïse, l’homme de Dieu, et les prêtres aspergeaient le sang qu’ils recevaient des Lévites.
fr.R: Ils se sont tenus à leurs places, comme le demandait la loi de Moïse, l’homme de Dieu. Les Lévites passaient le sang aux prêtres, et les prêtres l’aspergeaient sur l’autel.

sw.L: Wakasimama mahali pao sawasawa na taratibu zao, sawasawa na sheria ya Musa mtu wa Mungu; makuhani [walikuwa] wakinyunyiza damu [waliyoipokea] kutoka mkononi mwa Walawi.
sw.B: Walisimama mahali pao pa kawaida kama sheria ya Musa mtu wa Mungu inavyoagiza, nao makuhani wakairushia madhabahu damu waliyoipokea kutoka kwa Walawi.
sw.R: Walisimama mahali pao, kama sheria ya Musa, mtu wa Mungu, ilivyotaka. Walawi waliwapa makuhani damu, nao makuhani wakaimwagia madhabahu.

vi.L: Họ đứng tại vị trí mình theo luật lệ của họ, theo luật pháp của Môi-se, người của Đức Chúa Trời; các thầy tế lễ rảy máu [nhận] từ tay người Lê-vi.
vi.B: Họ đứng vào vị trí thường lệ theo luật pháp của Môi-se, người của Đức Chúa Trời, và các thầy tế lễ rảy máu họ nhận từ tay người Lê-vi.
vi.R: Họ đứng vào chỗ của mình, như luật pháp của Môi-se, người của Đức Chúa Trời, đã quy định. Người Lê-vi trao máu cho các thầy tế lễ, và các thầy tế lễ rảy máu ấy lên bàn thờ.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 하나님의 사람 모세의 율법에 따라 그들의 규례대로 자기 자리에 섰다. 제사장들은 레위인들의 손에서 [받은] 피를 뿌렸다.
ko.B: 그들은 하나님의 사람 모세의 율법이 정한 대로 각자 맡은 자리에 섰다. 제사장들은 레위인들에게서 받은 피를 뿌렸다.
ko.R: 그들은 하나님의 사람 모세의 율법이 정한 대로 각자 자기 자리에 섰다. 레위인들이 피를 제사장들에게 건네주면, 제사장들이 그 피를 제단에 뿌렸다.

pt.L: E ficaram no seu posto, segundo a sua ordenança, conforme a lei de Moisés, o homem de Deus; os sacerdotes [estavam] lançando o sangue [recebido] da mão dos levitas.
pt.B: Tomaram os seus lugares de costume, como prescreve a lei de Moisés, o homem de Deus, e os sacerdotes jogavam o sangue que recebiam dos levitas.
pt.R: Eles ficaram nos seus lugares, como mandava a lei de Moisés, o homem de Deus. Os levitas entregavam o sangue aos sacerdotes, e os sacerdotes o jogavam no altar.

decisions.choice: their station according to their ordinance: their assigned places and duties
decisions.reason: The word for ordinance can mean a rule or an established custom. Each group stood where its duty placed it at the altar.

decisions.choice: Moses the man of God
decisions.reason: "Man of God" is a title for a prophet. Moses is given it in Deuteronomy 33:1 and 1 Chronicles 23:14.

decisions.choice: the priests threw the blood received from the Levites
decisions.reason: The blood of an offering was thrown against the altar by the priests (Leviticus 1:5). Here the Levites, who had slaughtered the animals for many of the people (verse 17), handed the blood to the priests.

decisions.choice: throwing (Literal); splashed (Balanced, Readable); on the altar (Readable)
decisions.reason: As at Leviticus 1:5. Readable says where the blood went, which the law takes for granted.

decisions.choice: lançando (L); jogavam (B, R); a lei de Moisés
decisions.reason: The priests' act takes the verbs Leviticus 1:5 sets in Portuguese for throwing the blood (m3): "lançar" (L) and "jogar" (B, R). "A lei de Moisés" is lowercase, as the English and as Joshua 8:31 in Portuguese.

source.text: כִּי־רַבַּ֥ת בַּקָּהָ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־הִתְקַדָּ֑שׁוּ וְהַלְוִיִּ֞ם עַל־שְׁחִיטַ֣ת הַפְּסָחִ֗ים לְכֹל֙ לֹ֣א טָה֔וֹר לְהַקְדִּ֖ישׁ לַיהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: For many [were] in the assembly who not had consecrated themselves, and the Levites [were] over [the] slaughtering of the Passovers for everyone not clean, to consecrate [them] to Yahweh.

en.L: For [there were] many in the assembly who had not consecrated themselves; and the Levites [were] over the slaughtering of the Passovers for everyone [who was] not clean, to consecrate [them] to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Since many in the assembly had not consecrated themselves, the Levites took charge of slaughtering the Passover lambs for all who were not clean, to consecrate them to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Many people in the crowd had not made themselves holy. So the Levites had the job of killing the Passover lambs for everyone who was not ritually clean, so that the lambs would be holy to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Porque [había] muchos en la asamblea que no se habían santificado; y los levitas [estaban] a cargo de degollar las pascuas por todo el que no estaba limpio, para santificar[los] {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.B: Como muchos en la asamblea no se habían santificado, los levitas se encargaron de degollar los corderos de la Pascua por todos los que no estaban limpios, para consagrarlos {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.R: Mucha gente en la multitud no se había purificado. Por eso los levitas tenían el trabajo de matar los corderos de la Pascua por todos los que no estaban ritualmente limpios, para que los corderos fueran consagrados {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Car [il y en avait] beaucoup dans l’assemblée qui ne s’étaient pas consacrés ; et les Lévites [étaient] chargés d’égorger les [agneaux de la] Pâque pour tous ceux [qui n’étaient] pas purs, pour [les] consacrer {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Comme beaucoup de gens de l’assemblée ne s’étaient pas consacrés, les Lévites furent chargés d’égorger les agneaux de la Pâque pour tous ceux qui n’étaient pas purs, afin de les consacrer {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Beaucoup de gens de la foule ne s’étaient pas rendus saints. Alors les Lévites ont été chargés de tuer les agneaux de la Pâque pour tous ceux qui n’étaient pas purs selon la loi, pour que les agneaux soient consacrés {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Kwa maana [walikuwako] wengi katika kusanyiko ambao hawakuwa wamejitakasa; kwa hiyo Walawi [walisimamia] kuchinja Pasaka kwa ajili ya kila [mtu ambaye] hakuwa safi, ili [kuwatakasa] kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Kwa kuwa wengi katika kusanyiko hawakuwa wamejitakasa, Walawi walisimamia kazi ya kuchinja wana-kondoo wa Pasaka kwa ajili ya wote ambao hawakuwa safi, ili kuwaweka wakfu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Watu wengi katika umati hawakuwa wamejifanya kuwa watakatifu. Kwa hiyo Walawi walipewa kazi ya kuchinja wana-kondoo wa Pasaka kwa ajili ya kila mtu ambaye hakuwa safi kwa taratibu za ibada, ili wana-kondoo hao wawe watakatifu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Vì trong hội chúng có nhiều người chưa thánh hóa chính mình, nên người Lê-vi lo việc giết [chiên] Lễ Vượt Qua cho mọi người không tinh sạch, để thánh hóa [chúng] cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Vì nhiều người trong hội chúng chưa thánh hóa chính mình, nên người Lê-vi phụ trách việc giết chiên Lễ Vượt Qua cho mọi người không tinh sạch, để thánh hóa chúng cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Nhiều người trong đám đông chưa làm cho mình nên thánh. Vì vậy người Lê-vi lo việc giết chiên con Lễ Vượt Qua cho mọi người không tinh sạch theo nghi lễ, để chiên con được thánh cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 회중 가운데 자신을 거룩하게 하지 못한 자들이 많았기 때문이다. 그래서 레위인들이 깨끗하지 못한 모든 자를 위해 유월절 [양을] 잡는 일을 맡아, [그것들을] {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 거룩하게 했다.
ko.B: 회중 가운데 자신을 거룩하게 하지 못한 사람이 많았으므로, 레위인들이 깨끗하지 못한 모든 사람을 위해 유월절 양을 잡는 일을 맡아, 그것들을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 거룩하게 바쳤다.
ko.R: 모인 사람들 가운데 많은 사람이 자신을 거룩하게 하지 못했다. 그래서 레위인들이 정결하지 못한 모든 사람을 위해 유월절 양을 대신 잡았다. 그래서 그 양들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 거룩한 제물이 될 수 있었다.

pt.L: Porque [havia] muitos na assembleia que não tinham se consagrado; e os levitas [estavam] encarregados do abate das Páscoas para todo aquele [que] não [estava] puro, para [os] consagrar {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.
pt.B: Como muitos na assembleia não tinham se consagrado, os levitas ficaram encarregados de abater os cordeiros da Páscoa para todos os que não estavam puros, a fim de consagrá-los {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.
pt.R: Muitas pessoas da multidão não tinham se santificado. Por isso os levitas ficaram com a tarefa de matar os cordeiros da Páscoa para todos os que não estavam ritualmente puros. Assim os cordeiros seriam santos {{divine_name:para o SENHOR|para Javé}}.

decisions.choice: not clean: ritually unclean

decisions.choice: they ate the Passover not as written: while still unclean
decisions.reason: The law said that anyone unclean who ate a holy offering would be cut off from the people (Leviticus 7:20-21), and those unclean at Passover were to wait for the second month (Numbers 9:6-11). Many of the northerners had come too late or did not know the rules of cleansing, and they ate unclean.

decisions.choice: for ... for: yet they ate ... but Hezekiah prayed
decisions.reason: The same small word joins three clauses. The second marks what they did in spite of being unclean; the third explains why no harm followed: Hezekiah prayed for them, and Yahweh heard (verse 20).

decisions.choice: make atonement for: pardon
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used for making atonement by sacrifice. With Yahweh himself as the one who acts, it means to cover the wrong and pardon it, as in Deuteronomy 21:8 and Psalm 78:38. Hezekiah asks Yahweh to do what no rite had done.

decisions.choice: Yahweh, the good one: the prayer rests on his goodness
decisions.reason: The prayer calls on Yahweh by what he is. "Yahweh is good" was the song at the temple's dedication (5:13; 7:3; 1 Chronicles 16:34).

decisions.choice: make atonement for (Literal); pardon (Balanced); forgive (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the usual wording for this verb. Balanced and Readable say what it means when God is the one who acts (m3). Hezekiah's sentence runs on into verse 19, so this record ends in the middle of it.

decisions.choice: "haga expiación por" (L); "perdone a" (B, R)

decisions.choice: afanye upatanisho (L); amsamehe (B, R)

decisions.choice: The prayer's subject ends this record and its verb ends verse 19 ("선하신 주께서 ... 용서해 주시기를 빕니다")
alternatives: closing the sentence within each verse
decisions.reason: The record ends in the middle of Hezekiah's sentence, as the English does; Korean puts the verb last, so the wish "make atonement for / pardon" stands in verse 19 with its object, and each verse keeps its own words.

decisions.choice: the sentence runs on into verse 19, ending on "cho"
alternatives: closing each verse as its own sentence
decisions.reason: The prayer is one sentence across two records, as in the English; Vietnamese order (verb, then "cho", then the persons) lets each record end where the Hebrew verse ends.

decisions.choice: has set his heart to seek God: is determined to seek him
decisions.reason: To set the heart is to direct one's will, as Jehoshaphat "set his heart to seek God" (19:3). To seek God in Chronicles is to turn to him in worship and obedience.

decisions.choice: though not according to the purification of the sanctuary
decisions.reason: Hezekiah asks that those whose hearts are set on God be pardoned even though they lack the ritual cleanness the holy place requires. The rules of cleanness are not set aside; the prayer asks for mercy where they were broken.

decisions.choice: everyone ... his heart: any person, man or woman
decisions.reason: The pronoun is singular and masculine because it follows "everyone"; the prayer is for all the people who ate (verse 18).

decisions.choice: their (default); his (alternative)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use "their" for "everyone" (m3), with "his" as the alternative wording. Literal keeps the Hebrew pronoun. Readable says "made up their mind" for setting the heart, as at 19:3.

decisions.choice: "su", no gender setting

decisions.reason: French generic pronouns already include everyone, as the style guide sets, so French needs no span where the English has "their" / "his".

decisions.choice: no gender span

sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alilijibu ombi la Hezekia, akawaponya watu.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} lắng nghe Ê-xê-chia và chữa lành dân chúng.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nghe lời Ê-xê-chia và chữa lành dân chúng.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nhậm lời cầu nguyện của Ê-xê-chia và chữa lành dân chúng.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 히스기야의 [기도를] 들으시고 백성을 고쳐 주셨다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 히스기야의 기도를 들으시고 백성을 고쳐 주셨다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 히스기야의 기도에 응답하셔서 백성을 고쳐 주셨다.

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} ouviu Ezequias e curou o povo.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} ouviu Ezequias e curou o povo.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} atendeu à oração de Ezequias e curou o povo.

decisions.choice: Yahweh heard ... and healed: the promise of 7:14 kept
decisions.reason: Yahweh had promised Solomon that if his people humbled themselves, prayed and sought him, he would hear from heaven, forgive their sin and heal their land (7:14). The northerners humbled themselves (verse 11), sought God (verse 19) and Hezekiah prayed for them; now Yahweh hears and heals.

decisions.choice: healed the people: spared them and made them whole
alternatives: he cured an illness that had come on them
decisions.reason: The law warned that uncleanness near Yahweh's dwelling brought death (Leviticus 15:31). Healing may mean that Yahweh kept the people from sickness or harm that their eating unclean could bring, or that he forgave them and restored them to himself, as healing is used in 7:14 and Hosea 14:5. The verse does not say that anyone had fallen ill.

decisions.choice: listened to (Literal); heard (Balanced); answered Hezekiah's prayer (Readable)
decisions.reason: The verb means both to hear and to respond. Readable says plainly that Yahweh did what Hezekiah asked.

decisions.choice: ouviu (L, B), atendeu à oração (R); curou
decisions.reason: "Ouvir" and "curar" are the verbs of the promise of 7:14 in Portuguese ("eu ouvirei ... e curarei"), which this verse sees kept (m1).

source.text: וַיַּעֲשׂ֣וּ בְנֵֽי־יִ֠שְׂרָאֵל הַנִּמְצְאִ֨ים בִּירוּשָׁלִַ֜ם אֶת־חַ֧ג הַמַּצּ֛וֹת שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים בְּשִׂמְחָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֑ה וּֽמְהַלְלִ֣ים לַ֠יהוָה י֣וֹם׀בְּי֞וֹם הַלְוִיִּ֧ם וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֛ים בִּכְלֵי־עֹ֖ז לַיהוָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And did [the] sons of Israel the [ones] present in Jerusalem the festival of the unleavened [bread] seven days with joy great, and praising Yahweh day by day the Levites and the priests with instruments of strength to Yahweh.

en.L: And the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel who were present in Jerusalem kept the festival of unleavened bread seven days with great joy, and the Levites and the priests [were] praising {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} day by day with instruments of strength to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: The {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} who were present in Jerusalem kept the Festival of Unleavened Bread for seven days with great joy, while the Levites and the priests praised {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} day after day, playing loud instruments for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: The {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} who were in Jerusalem celebrated the Festival of Unleavened Bread for seven days, and they were full of joy. Every day the Levites and priests praised {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, playing loud instruments to honor {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: Y los hijos de Israel que estaban presentes en Jerusalén celebraron la fiesta de los Panes sin Levadura siete días con gran alegría, y los levitas y los sacerdotes alababan {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} día tras día con instrumentos de poder {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.B: Los israelitas que estaban en Jerusalén celebraron la fiesta de los Panes sin Levadura durante siete días con gran alegría, mientras los levitas y los sacerdotes alababan {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} día tras día, tocando con fuerza sus instrumentos para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Los israelitas que estaban en Jerusalén celebraron la fiesta de los Panes sin Levadura durante siete días, llenos de alegría. Todos los días los levitas y los sacerdotes alababan {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, tocando con fuerza sus instrumentos para honrar{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}}.

fr.L: Et les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël qui se trouvaient à Jérusalem célébrèrent la fête des pains sans levain sept jours avec une grande joie, et les Lévites et les prêtres louaient {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} jour après jour avec des instruments de force pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} qui se trouvaient à Jérusalem célébrèrent la fête des Pains sans levain pendant sept jours avec une grande joie, tandis que les Lévites et les prêtres louaient {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} jour après jour, en jouant d’instruments sonores pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} qui étaient à Jérusalem ont célébré la fête des Pains sans levain pendant sept jours, et ils étaient pleins de joie. Chaque jour, les Lévites et les prêtres louaient {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} en jouant d’instruments sonores pour {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}honorer.

sw.L: Na wana wa Israeli waliokuwapo Yerusalemu wakafanya sikukuu ya mikate isiyotiwa chachu siku saba kwa furaha kubwa, na Walawi na makuhani [walikuwa] wakimsifu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} siku kwa siku kwa vyombo vya nguvu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Waisraeli waliokuwapo Yerusalemu waliifanya Sikukuu ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu kwa siku saba kwa furaha kubwa, huku Walawi na makuhani wakimsifu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} siku baada ya siku, wakipiga vyombo vya sauti kuu kwa ajili ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Waisraeli waliokuwa Yerusalemu walisherehekea Sikukuu ya Mikate Isiyotiwa Chachu kwa siku saba, wakiwa wamejaa furaha. Kila siku Walawi na makuhani walimsifu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wakipiga vyombo vya sauti kubwa kwa heshima {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.

vi.L: Con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên có mặt tại Giê-ru-sa-lem giữ Lễ Bánh Không Men bảy ngày cách rất vui mừng; người Lê-vi và các thầy tế lễ ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ngày này qua ngày khác bằng các nhạc cụ mạnh mẽ dâng lên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Dân Y-sơ-ra-ên có mặt tại Giê-ru-sa-lem giữ Lễ Bánh Không Men trong bảy ngày với niềm vui lớn, trong khi người Lê-vi và các thầy tế lễ ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ngày này qua ngày khác, chơi các nhạc cụ vang lừng dâng lên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Dân Y-sơ-ra-ên có mặt tại Giê-ru-sa-lem mừng Lễ Bánh Không Men trong bảy ngày, lòng đầy vui mừng. Mỗi ngày người Lê-vi và các thầy tế lễ ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, chơi các nhạc cụ vang lừng để tôn vinh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그리고 예루살렘에 있던 이스라엘 자손이 7일 동안 큰 기쁨으로 무교절을 지켰다. 그리고 레위인들과 제사장들이 날마다 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 힘찬 악기로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찬양했다.
ko.B: 예루살렘에 있던 이스라엘 자손은 7일 동안 크게 기뻐하며 무교절을 지켰다. 레위인들과 제사장들은 날마다 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 우렁찬 악기를 연주하며 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찬양했다.
ko.R: 예루살렘에 모인 이스라엘 사람들은 7일 동안 무교절을 지키며 아주 기뻐했다. 레위인들과 제사장들은 날마다 우렁찬 악기를 연주하며 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찬양했다.

pt.L: E os filhos de Israel que se acharam em Jerusalém celebraram a festa dos Pães sem Fermento sete dias com grande alegria; e os levitas e os sacerdotes [estavam] louvando {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dia após dia com instrumentos de força {{divine_name:para o SENHOR|para Javé}}.
pt.B: Os israelitas que estavam presentes em Jerusalém celebraram a festa dos Pães sem Fermento durante sete dias com grande alegria, enquanto os levitas e os sacerdotes louvavam {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dia após dia, tocando instrumentos de som forte em honra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: Os israelitas que estavam em Jerusalém celebraram a festa dos Pães sem Fermento durante sete dias, cheios de alegria. Todos os dias os levitas e os sacerdotes louvavam {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, tocando instrumentos de som forte em honra {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}.

decisions.choice: with instruments of strength to Yahweh: loud instruments played for him
alternatives: praising Yahweh with all their strength
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text reads "with instruments of strength". A very similar phrase, "with all strength", describes David's worship before the ark (1 Chronicles 13:8), and some read that here by a small change of letters: "praising Yahweh with all their strength". The record follows the Hebrew text. Either way the praise was loud and wholehearted.

decisions.choice: who were present: those who were found there
decisions.reason: The word means "those who were found" in Jerusalem: everyone who had come, from the north and the south alike.

decisions.choice: the Levites and the priests praising Yahweh
decisions.reason: Hezekiah had restored the Levite singers and players with the instruments of David and the priests with trumpets (29:25-28), as David had set them in order (1 Chronicles 15:16; 16:4-6).

decisions.choice: loud instruments (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "instruments of strength". Balanced and Readable say what the phrase describes, the sound of the music. Readable uses "him" for the second mention of the divine name.

decisions.choice: os israelitas, with no gender span; instrumentos de som forte (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in verse 6, "os israelitas" includes everyone and needs no setting. Literal keeps "instrumentos de força" (m1); Balanced and Readable say what the phrase describes, as the English "loud instruments".

source.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְחִזְקִיָּ֗הוּ עַל־לֵב֙ כָּל־הַלְוִיִּ֔ם הַמַּשְׂכִּילִ֥ים שֵֽׂכֶל־ט֖וֹב לַיהוָ֑ה וַיֹּאכְל֤וּ אֶת־הַמּוֹעֵד֙ שִׁבְעַ֣ת הַיָּמִ֔ים מְזַבְּחִים֙ זִבְחֵ֣י שְׁלָמִ֔ים וּמִ֨תְוַדִּ֔ים לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And spoke Hezekiah to [the] heart of all the Levites the [ones] showing understanding good to Yahweh, and they ate the appointed [feast] seven the days, sacrificing sacrifices of peace offerings and giving thanks to Yahweh God of their fathers.

en.L: And Hezekiah spoke to the heart of all the Levites who showed good understanding toward {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. And they ate the appointed feast seven days, sacrificing sacrifices of peace offerings and giving thanks to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the God of their fathers.
en.B: Hezekiah spoke encouragingly to all the Levites who showed good skill in the service of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. For the seven days of the festival they ate the festival meals, offering peace offerings and giving thanks to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of their ancestors.
en.R: Hezekiah encouraged all the Levites, who had shown such good skill in serving {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. For seven days the people ate the festival meals. They offered peace offerings and thanked {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of their ancestors.

es.L: Y Ezequías habló al corazón de todos los levitas que mostraban buen entendimiento [en el servicio] {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Y comieron [durante] la fiesta siete días, ofreciendo sacrificios de paz y dando gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, el Dios de sus padres.
es.B: Ezequías animó a todos los levitas que mostraban buena destreza en el servicio {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Durante los siete días de la fiesta comieron las comidas de la fiesta, ofreciendo sacrificios de paz y dando gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, el Dios de sus antepasados.
es.R: Ezequías animó a todos los levitas, que habían mostrado tanta destreza en el servicio {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Durante siete días la gente comió las comidas de la fiesta. Ofrecieron sacrificios de paz y dieron gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, el Dios de sus antepasados.

fr.L: Et Ézéchias parla au cœur de tous les Lévites qui montraient une bonne intelligence envers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Et ils mangèrent [le repas de] la fête sept jours, offrant des sacrifices de communion et rendant grâce {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, le Dieu de leurs pères.
fr.B: Ézéchias adressa des paroles d’encouragement à tous les Lévites qui faisaient preuve d’une grande habileté au service {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Pendant les sept jours de la fête, on mangea les repas de fête, en offrant des sacrifices de communion et en rendant grâce {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, le Dieu de ses ancêtres.
fr.R: Ézéchias a encouragé tous les Lévites, qui avaient montré tant d’habileté au service {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Pendant sept jours, le peuple a mangé les repas de fête. Les gens offraient des sacrifices de communion et remerciaient {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu de leurs ancêtres.

sw.L: Hezekia akasema na moyo wa Walawi wote waliokuwa na ufahamu mzuri kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Nao wakala sikukuu siku saba, wakitoa dhabihu za sadaka za amani na kumshukuru {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wa baba zao.
sw.B: Hezekia aliwatia moyo Walawi wote waliokuwa wameonyesha ustadi mzuri katika huduma ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Kwa siku saba za sikukuu walikula vyakula vya sikukuu, wakitoa sadaka za amani na kumshukuru {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa babu zao.
sw.R: Hezekia aliwatia moyo Walawi wote, waliokuwa wameonyesha ustadi mkubwa katika kumtumikia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Kwa siku saba watu walikula vyakula vya sikukuu. Walitoa sadaka za amani na kumshukuru {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa babu zao.

vi.L: Ê-xê-chia nói lời khích lệ lòng mọi người Lê-vi có hiểu biết tốt về [sự phục vụ] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Họ ăn lễ trong bảy ngày, dâng các sinh tế bình an và cảm tạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tổ phụ họ.
vi.B: Ê-xê-chia khích lệ tất cả người Lê-vi đã tỏ ra thành thạo trong việc phục vụ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Trong suốt bảy ngày lễ, họ ăn các bữa tiệc lễ, dâng tế lễ bình an và cảm tạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tổ tiên họ.
vi.R: Ê-xê-chia khích lệ tất cả người Lê-vi, là những người đã phục vụ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} rất giỏi. Suốt bảy ngày, dân chúng ăn các bữa tiệc lễ. Họ dâng tế lễ bình an và cảm tạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tổ tiên họ.

ko.L: 그리고 히스기야가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 대해 좋은 깨달음을 보인 모든 레위인의 마음에 말했다. 그리고 그들이 7일 동안 절기 [음식을] 먹으며, 화목제물을 드리고 그들의 조상들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 감사했다.
ko.B: 히스기야는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 섬기는 일에 뛰어난 솜씨를 보인 모든 레위인을 격려했다. 절기 7일 동안 그들은 절기 음식을 먹으며, 화목제물을 드리고 조상들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 감사했다.
ko.R: 히스기야는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 아주 잘 섬긴 모든 레위인을 격려했다. 백성은 7일 동안 절기 음식을 먹었다. 그들은 화목제물을 드리고 조상들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 감사했다.

pt.L: E Ezequias falou ao coração de todos os levitas que mostravam bom entendimento para com {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. E comeram a festa fixa os sete dias, sacrificando sacrifícios de comunhão e rendendo graças {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o Deus dos seus pais.
pt.B: Ezequias falou com palavras de ânimo a todos os levitas que mostravam boa habilidade no serviço {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Durante os sete dias da festa, comeram as refeições festivas, oferecendo sacrifícios de comunhão e rendendo graças {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o Deus dos seus antepassados.
pt.R: Ezequias encorajou todos os levitas, que tinham mostrado tanta habilidade no serviço {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Durante sete dias o povo comeu as refeições da festa. Ofereceram sacrifícios de comunhão e agradeceram {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o Deus dos seus antepassados.

decisions.choice: spoke to the heart of: encouraged, spoke kindly to
decisions.reason: To speak to someone's heart is to speak to comfort or encourage, as Joseph did to his brothers (Genesis 50:21) and Hezekiah to his officers (32:6); compare Isaiah 40:2.

decisions.choice: who showed good understanding toward Yahweh: skilled in his service
decisions.reason: The phrase may mean skill in leading the worship and music, or insight in teaching the people, as the Levites later explained the law (Nehemiah 8:7-8). Either way Hezekiah commends Levites who served Yahweh well.

decisions.choice: they ate the appointed feast: ate the meals of the festival
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says they "ate the appointed feast", meaning the meals of the festival, chiefly the meat of the peace offerings. The ancient Greek translation reads "they completed the feast", from a word that differs by one letter. The record follows the Hebrew text.

decisions.choice: giving thanks: or making confession
decisions.reason: The verb means to acknowledge, either praising Yahweh with thanks or confessing sin before him (Ezra 10:11; Nehemiah 9:3). With peace offerings, and in a week of joy, thanksgiving is the more likely sense.

decisions.choice: the festival meals (Balanced, Readable); the people (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "ate the appointed feast" refers to (m3). Readable names the people as the ones who ate, since the whole assembly kept the feast (verse 23). Readable says "encouraged" for the idiom in m1.

decisions.choice: "habló al corazón" (L); "animó" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture, which Spanish can follow; Balanced and Readable give its sense (m1).

decisions.choice: "마음에 말했다" at Literal
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew phrase "spoke to the heart" (m1); Balanced and Readable say "encouraged".

decisions.choice: a festa fixa (L); as refeições festivas (B), as refeições da festa (R); sacrifícios de comunhão; rendendo graças (L, B), agradeceram (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew "ate the appointed feast" with "festa fixa", the word 8:13 uses for the appointed feasts; Balanced and Readable say what was eaten (m3). Peace offerings are "sacrifícios de comunhão", as the Old Testament terms, and the thanks (m4) are "render graças" (L, B) and "agradecer" (R), as 5:13.

source.text: וַיִּוָּֽעֲצוּ֙ כָּל־הַקָּהָ֔ל לַעֲשׂ֕וֹת שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים אֲחֵרִ֑ים וַיַּֽעֲשׂ֥וּ שִׁבְעַת־יָמִ֖ים שִׂמְחָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And took counsel all the assembly to do seven days other, and they did seven days [with] joy.

en.L: And all the assembly took counsel to keep another seven days, and they kept seven days [with] joy.
en.B: Then the whole assembly decided to keep the festival for another seven days, and they kept seven more days with joy.
en.R: Then all the people decided to celebrate for seven more days. So they celebrated another seven days, full of joy.

es.L: Y toda la asamblea tomó consejo para celebrar otros siete días, y celebraron siete días [con] alegría.
es.B: Entonces toda la asamblea decidió celebrar la fiesta otros siete días, y celebraron siete días más con alegría.
es.R: Entonces toda la gente decidió celebrar siete días más. Así que celebraron otros siete días, llenos de alegría.

fr.L: Et toute l’assemblée tint conseil pour célébrer sept autres jours, et ils célébrèrent sept jours [dans] la joie.
fr.B: Puis toute l’assemblée décida de prolonger la fête de sept jours, et l’on célébra sept jours de plus dans la joie.
fr.R: Ensuite tout le peuple a décidé de faire la fête sept jours de plus. Ils ont donc fait la fête encore sept jours, pleins de joie.

sw.L: Kusanyiko lote likafanya shauri kufanya siku saba nyingine, nao wakafanya siku saba [kwa] furaha.
sw.B: Kisha kusanyiko lote likaamua kuifanya sikukuu kwa siku saba nyingine, nao wakafanya siku saba zaidi kwa furaha.
sw.R: Kisha watu wote waliamua kusherehekea kwa siku saba zaidi. Kwa hiyo wakasherehekea siku saba nyingine, wakiwa wamejaa furaha.

vi.L: Cả hội chúng bàn bạc để giữ thêm bảy ngày khác, và họ giữ bảy ngày [trong] vui mừng.
vi.B: Rồi cả hội chúng quyết định giữ lễ thêm bảy ngày nữa, và họ vui mừng giữ thêm bảy ngày.
vi.R: Rồi toàn dân quyết định mừng lễ thêm bảy ngày nữa. Vậy họ mừng lễ thêm bảy ngày, lòng đầy vui mừng.

ko.L: 그리고 온 회중이 다른 7일을 지키기로 의논하고, 기쁨으로 7일을 지켰다.
ko.B: 그러자 온 회중은 절기를 7일 더 지키기로 결정하고, 기쁘게 7일을 더 지켰다.
ko.R: 그러자 모든 백성은 7일 동안 더 절기를 지키기로 했다. 그래서 그들은 7일을 더 기쁘게 지냈다.

pt.L: E toda a assembleia tomou conselho para celebrar outros sete dias; e celebraram sete dias [com] alegria.
pt.B: Então toda a assembleia decidiu celebrar a festa por mais sete dias, e celebraram mais sete dias com alegria.
pt.R: Depois todo o povo decidiu continuar a festa por mais sete dias. E assim festejaram mais uma semana, cheios de alegria.

decisions.choice: another seven days: as at the dedication of Solomon's temple
decisions.reason: At the dedication of the temple Solomon and all Israel celebrated for seven days and then seven more (7:8-9; 1 Kings 8:65). This second week brings that feast to mind, as verse 26 says outright.

decisions.choice: took counsel: the assembly decided together
decisions.reason: The same verb as in verse 2, where the king, his officials and the assembly made the first decision. Now the whole assembly decides on its own to go on.

decisions.choice: the festival (Balanced)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "to do another seven days". Balanced supplies what was kept; Readable says "celebrate".

decisions.choice: Days of a feast in figures ("7일")
decisions.reason: Counts of days for the feasts are written in figures, like the dates of 29:17 and the years of this block.

source.text: כִּ֣י חִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־יְ֠הוּדָה הֵרִ֨ים לַקָּהָ֜ל אֶ֣לֶף פָּרִים֮ וְשִׁבְעַ֣ת אֲלָפִ֣ים צֹאן֒סוְהַשָּׂרִ֞ים הֵרִ֤ימוּ לַקָּהָל֙ פָּרִ֣ים אֶ֔לֶף וְצֹ֖אן עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת אֲלָפִ֑ים וַיִּֽתְקַדְּשׁ֥וּ כֹהֲנִ֖ים לָרֹֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: For Hezekiah king of Judah contributed for the assembly a thousand bulls and seven thousand sheep, and the princes contributed for the assembly bulls a thousand and sheep ten thousand; and consecrated themselves priests in multitude.

en.L: For Hezekiah king of Judah contributed to the assembly 1,000 bulls and 7,000 sheep, and the princes contributed to the assembly 1,000 bulls and 10,000 sheep; and priests consecrated themselves in multitude.
en.B: Hezekiah king of Judah provided 1,000 bulls and 7,000 sheep for the assembly, and the officials provided 1,000 bulls and 10,000 sheep. A great number of priests consecrated themselves.
en.R: King Hezekiah of Judah gave the people 1,000 bulls and 7,000 sheep and goats, and the leaders gave them 1,000 bulls and 10,000 sheep and goats. And many priests made themselves holy.

es.L: Porque Ezequías rey de Judá había dado a la asamblea 1 000 toros y 7 000 ovejas, y los príncipes dieron a la asamblea 1 000 toros y 10 000 ovejas; y se santificaron sacerdotes en gran número.
es.B: Ezequías rey de Judá había donado a la asamblea 1 000 toros y 7 000 ovejas, y los jefes donaron 1 000 toros y 10 000 ovejas. Un gran número de sacerdotes se santificó.
es.R: El rey Ezequías de Judá le dio a la gente 1 000 toros y 7 000 ovejas y cabras, y los dirigentes le dieron 1 000 toros y 10 000 ovejas y cabras. Y muchos sacerdotes se purificaron.

fr.L: Car Ézéchias, roi de Juda, avait prélevé pour l’assemblée mille taureaux et sept mille moutons, et les princes avaient prélevé pour l’assemblée mille taureaux et dix mille moutons ; et des prêtres se consacrèrent en grand nombre.
fr.B: Ézéchias, roi de Juda, avait fourni à l’assemblée mille taureaux et sept mille moutons, et les chefs lui avaient fourni mille taureaux et dix mille moutons. Un grand nombre de prêtres se consacrèrent.
fr.R: Le roi Ézéchias de Juda avait donné au peuple mille taureaux et sept mille moutons et chèvres, et les chefs lui avaient donné mille taureaux et dix mille moutons et chèvres. Et beaucoup de prêtres se sont rendus saints.

sw.L: Kwa maana Hezekia mfalme wa Yuda alitoa kwa ajili ya kusanyiko mafahali 1,000 na kondoo 7,000, nao wakuu wakatoa kwa ajili ya kusanyiko mafahali 1,000 na kondoo 10,000; na makuhani wengi wakajitakasa.
sw.B: Hezekia mfalme wa Yuda alitoa mafahali 1,000 na kondoo 7,000 kwa ajili ya kusanyiko, nao maafisa wakatoa mafahali 1,000 na kondoo 10,000. Makuhani wengi sana walijitakasa.
sw.R: Mfalme Hezekia wa Yuda aliwapa watu mafahali 1,000 na kondoo na mbuzi 7,000, nao viongozi wakawapa mafahali 1,000 na kondoo na mbuzi 10,000. Na makuhani wengi walijifanya kuwa watakatifu.

vi.L: Vì Ê-xê-chia vua Giu-đa đã dâng cho hội chúng một nghìn con bò đực và bảy nghìn con chiên, và các thủ lĩnh dâng cho hội chúng một nghìn con bò đực và mười nghìn con chiên; và rất đông thầy tế lễ đã thánh hóa chính mình.
vi.B: Ê-xê-chia vua Giu-đa đã cung cấp cho hội chúng 1.000 con bò đực và 7.000 con chiên, còn các quan chức cung cấp 1.000 con bò đực và 10.000 con chiên. Rất đông thầy tế lễ đã thánh hóa chính mình.
vi.R: Vua Ê-xê-chia của Giu-đa ban cho dân chúng 1.000 con bò đực và 7.000 con chiên dê, còn các người lãnh đạo ban cho họ 1.000 con bò đực và 10.000 con chiên dê. Và có nhiều thầy tế lễ đã làm cho mình nên thánh.

ko.L: 유다 왕 히스기야가 회중에게 수소 1,000마리와 양 7,000마리를 내놓았고, 지도자들도 회중에게 수소 1,000마리와 양 10,000마리를 내놓았기 때문이다. 그리고 많은 제사장이 자신을 거룩하게 했다.
ko.B: 유다 왕 히스기야는 회중에게 수소 1,000마리와 양 7,000마리를 내주었고, 관리들도 회중에게 수소 1,000마리와 양 10,000마리를 내주었다. 그리고 아주 많은 제사장이 자신을 거룩하게 했다.
ko.R: 유다 왕 히스기야는 백성에게 수소 1,000마리와 양과 염소 7,000마리를 주었다. 지도자들도 백성에게 수소 1,000마리와 양과 염소 10,000마리를 주었다. 그리고 많은 제사장이 자신을 거룩하게 했다.

pt.L: Porque Ezequias, rei de Judá, contribuiu para a assembleia [com] mil novilhos e sete mil ovelhas, e os príncipes contribuíram para a assembleia [com] mil novilhos e dez mil ovelhas; e sacerdotes se consagraram em multidão.
pt.B: Ezequias, rei de Judá, deu à assembleia mil novilhos e sete mil ovelhas, e os oficiais deram mil novilhos e dez mil ovelhas. Um grande número de sacerdotes se consagrou.
pt.R: O rei Ezequias, de Judá, deu ao povo mil novilhos e sete mil ovelhas e cabras, e os líderes deram mil novilhos e dez mil ovelhas e cabras. E muitos sacerdotes se santificaram.

decisions.choice: contributed: set aside as a gift for the offerings
decisions.reason: The verb means "lifted up", used of setting something apart as a gift for holy use. Josiah and his officials later gave animals to the people for the Passover in the same way (35:7-8). Most of these animals were peace offerings, eaten by the worshipers (verse 22).

decisions.choice: sheep: animals of the flock
decisions.reason: The word means the flock, which takes in both sheep and goats.

decisions.choice: priests consecrated themselves in multitude: now there were enough
decisions.reason: The same phrase as in verse 5 for numbers. In the first month there were too few consecrated priests (verse 3); now a great number of them were ready to serve.

decisions.choice: sheep (Literal, Balanced); sheep and goats (Readable); princes, officials, leaders
decisions.reason: Readable names both animals of the flock (m2). The word for the king's chief men follows the wording used in verse 2.

decisions.choice: mil, sete mil, dez mil (in words); novilhos
decisions.reason: The round numbers are written in words, as Chronicles' Portuguese does (style section 5), where the English gives figures. The bulls are "novilhos", the Pentateuch's word for the sacrificial bull.

source.text: וַֽיִּשְׂמְח֣וּ׀כָּל־קְהַ֣ל יְהוּדָ֗ה וְהַכֹּהֲנִים֙ וְהַלְוִיִּ֔ם וְכָל־הַקָּהָ֖ל הַבָּאִ֣ים מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְהַגֵּרִ֗ים הַבָּאִים֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְהַיּוֹשְׁבִ֖ים בִּיהוּדָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And rejoiced all [the] assembly of Judah and the priests and the Levites and all the assembly the [ones] coming from Israel, and the sojourners the [ones] coming from [the] land of Israel and the [ones] dwelling in Judah.

en.L: And all the assembly of Judah rejoiced, and the priests and the Levites, and all the assembly that came from Israel, and the sojourners who came from the land of Israel and who dwelt in Judah.
en.B: The whole assembly of Judah rejoiced, together with the priests and the Levites, the whole assembly that had come from Israel, and the outsiders who had come from the land of Israel or who lived in Judah.
en.R: All the people of Judah were full of joy. So were the priests and Levites, all the people who had come from Israel, and the outsiders who had come from the land of Israel or who lived in Judah.

es.L: Y se alegró toda la asamblea de Judá, y los sacerdotes y los levitas, y toda la asamblea que vino de Israel, y los extranjeros que vinieron de la tierra de Israel y los que habitaban en Judá.
es.B: Toda la asamblea de Judá se alegró, junto con los sacerdotes y los levitas, toda la asamblea que había venido de Israel y los extranjeros que habían venido de la tierra de Israel o que vivían en Judá.
es.R: Toda la gente de Judá estaba llena de alegría. También lo estaban los sacerdotes y los levitas, toda la gente que había venido de Israel y los extranjeros que habían venido de la tierra de Israel o que vivían en Judá.

fr.L: Et toute l’assemblée de Juda se réjouit, et les prêtres et les Lévites, et toute l’assemblée venue d’Israël, et les immigrés venus du pays d’Israël et ceux qui habitaient en Juda.
fr.B: Toute l’assemblée de Juda se réjouit, avec les prêtres et les Lévites, toute l’assemblée venue d’Israël, et les immigrés venus du pays d’Israël ou établis en Juda.
fr.R: Tout le peuple de Juda était plein de joie. Les prêtres et les Lévites aussi, ainsi que tous ceux qui étaient venus d’Israël, et les étrangers venus du pays d’Israël ou qui habitaient en Juda.

sw.L: Kusanyiko lote la Yuda likafurahi, na makuhani na Walawi, na kusanyiko lote lililokuja kutoka Israeli, na wageni waliokuja kutoka nchi ya Israeli na waliokaa Yuda.
sw.B: Kusanyiko lote la Yuda lilifurahi, pamoja na makuhani na Walawi, kusanyiko lote lililokuja kutoka Israeli, na wageni waliokuja kutoka nchi ya Israeli au walioishi Yuda.
sw.R: Watu wote wa Yuda walijaa furaha. Vivyo hivyo makuhani na Walawi, watu wote waliokuja kutoka Israeli, na wageni waliokuja kutoka nchi ya Israeli au walioishi Yuda.

vi.L: Cả hội chúng Giu-đa vui mừng, cùng các thầy tế lễ và người Lê-vi, cả hội chúng đến từ Y-sơ-ra-ên, và những khách kiều ngụ đến từ xứ Y-sơ-ra-ên và những người sống tại Giu-đa.
vi.B: Cả hội chúng Giu-đa vui mừng, cùng với các thầy tế lễ và người Lê-vi, cả hội chúng đã đến từ Y-sơ-ra-ên, và những người ngoại kiều đến từ xứ Y-sơ-ra-ên hoặc sống tại Giu-đa.
vi.R: Toàn dân Giu-đa đều vui mừng. Các thầy tế lễ và người Lê-vi cũng vậy, cùng mọi người đã đến từ Y-sơ-ra-ên, và những người ngoại kiều đến từ xứ Y-sơ-ra-ên hoặc sống tại Giu-đa.

ko.L: 그리고 유다의 온 회중과 제사장들과 레위인들과 이스라엘에서 온 온 회중과, 이스라엘 땅에서 온 나그네들과 유다에 사는 [나그네들이] 기뻐했다.
ko.B: 유다의 온 회중과 제사장들과 레위인들과 이스라엘에서 온 온 회중이 기뻐했다. 이스라엘 땅에서 온 나그네들과 유다에 사는 나그네들도 함께 기뻐했다.
ko.R: 유다의 모든 백성이 기뻐했다. 제사장들과 레위인들과 이스라엘에서 온 모든 사람도 기뻐했다. 이스라엘 땅에서 온 외국 사람들과 유다에 사는 외국 사람들도 기뻐했다.

pt.L: E toda a assembleia de Judá se alegrou, e os sacerdotes e os levitas, e toda a assembleia que veio de Israel, e os estrangeiros que vieram da terra de Israel e os que moravam em Judá.
pt.B: Toda a assembleia de Judá se alegrou, junto com os sacerdotes e os levitas, toda a assembleia que tinha vindo de Israel e os estrangeiros que tinham vindo da terra de Israel ou que moravam em Judá.
pt.R: Todo o povo de Judá ficou cheio de alegria. Também ficaram alegres os sacerdotes e os levitas, todos os que tinham vindo de Israel e os estrangeiros que tinham vindo da terra de Israel ou que moravam em Judá.

decisions.choice: the sojourners: foreigners living among Israel
decisions.reason: A sojourner was someone of another people who had settled in Israel. The law let a sojourner keep the Passover if the males of the household were circumcised, under the same law as an Israelite (Exodus 12:48-49; Numbers 9:14).

decisions.choice: and those who dwelt in Judah: sojourners living in Judah
decisions.reason: The last phrase most likely names a second group of sojourners: some came from the north, others lived in Judah. It could instead name the people of Judah again, but they have already been named at the start of the verse.

decisions.choice: all the assembly: one people rejoicing together
decisions.reason: Judah, the priests and Levites, the northern tribes and the foreigners among them rejoiced together. For a time the divided people worshiped as one.

decisions.choice: sojourners (Literal); outsiders (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The word for a resident foreigner follows the wording used across these books.

decisions.choice: "los extranjeros"
decisions.reason: The resident foreigner (*ger*) as the Pentateuch note names it, at every level.

decisions.choice: "les immigrés" (Literal, Balanced); "les étrangers" (Readable)
decisions.reason: *ger* as in the French Pentateuch ("immigré"); Readable uses the everyday word.

decisions.choice: "khách kiều ngụ" (L); "người ngoại kiều" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Foreigners living among Israel (m1), following the English sojourners / outsiders, as the 2 Kings drafts' "kiều ngụ".

decisions.choice: "나그네" (Literal, Balanced), "외국 사람" (Readable) for the sojourners
decisions.reason: "나그네" is the familiar Bible word for a foreigner settled among Israel (m1); Readable says plainly that they were from other peoples.

decisions.choice: os estrangeiros (every level)
decisions.reason: As 2:16 in Portuguese and the Old Testament terms: the resident foreigner (m1) is "estrangeiro" at every level, with "que moravam" saying that they lived among Israel, where the English says "outsiders" at Balanced and Readable.

source.text: וַתְּהִ֥י שִׂמְחָֽה־גְדוֹלָ֖ה בִּֽירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כִּ֠י מִימֵ֞י שְׁלֹמֹ֤ה בֶן־דָּוִיד֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹ֥א כָזֹ֖את בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And there was joy great in Jerusalem, for from [the] days of Solomon son of David king of Israel not like this in Jerusalem.

en.L: And there was great joy in Jerusalem, for since the days of Solomon son of David king of Israel [there had been] nothing like this in Jerusalem.
en.B: So there was great joy in Jerusalem, because nothing like this had happened in Jerusalem since the time of Solomon son of David, king of Israel.
en.R: Jerusalem was full of joy. Nothing like this had happened there since the time of King Solomon, David's son, who ruled all Israel.

es.L: Y hubo gran alegría en Jerusalén, porque desde los días de Salomón hijo de David, rey de Israel, no [había habido] nada semejante en Jerusalén.
es.B: Hubo, pues, gran alegría en Jerusalén, porque desde el tiempo de Salomón hijo de David, rey de Israel, no había sucedido nada semejante en Jerusalén.
es.R: Jerusalén estaba llena de alegría. No había sucedido nada así allí desde el tiempo del rey Salomón, hijo de David, que gobernó a todo Israel.

fr.L: Et il y eut une grande joie à Jérusalem, car depuis les jours de Salomon, fils de David, roi d’Israël, [il n’y avait rien eu] de pareil à Jérusalem.
fr.B: Il y eut donc une grande joie à Jérusalem, car rien de pareil ne s’était vu à Jérusalem depuis l’époque de Salomon, fils de David, roi d’Israël.
fr.R: Jérusalem était pleine de joie. On n’avait rien vu de pareil depuis l’époque du roi Salomon, fils de David, qui régnait sur tout Israël.

sw.L: Kukawa na furaha kubwa katika Yerusalemu, kwa maana tangu siku za Sulemani mwana wa Daudi mfalme wa Israeli [hapakuwa] na kitu kama hiki katika Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Basi kukawa na furaha kubwa katika Yerusalemu, kwa sababu tangu wakati wa Sulemani mwana wa Daudi, mfalme wa Israeli, hapakuwa na jambo kama hili katika Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Yerusalemu ilijaa furaha. Hapakuwa na jambo kama hili huko tangu wakati wa mfalme Sulemani, mwana wa Daudi, aliyetawala Israeli yote.

vi.L: Có niềm vui lớn tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, vì từ thời Sa-lô-môn con trai Đa-vít vua Y-sơ-ra-ên, [chưa có] điều gì như thế tại Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Vậy tại Giê-ru-sa-lem có niềm vui lớn, vì từ thời Sa-lô-môn con trai Đa-vít, vua Y-sơ-ra-ên, chưa hề có việc gì như thế tại Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: Giê-ru-sa-lem tràn ngập niềm vui. Từ thời vua Sa-lô-môn, con trai Đa-vít, là vua cai trị cả Y-sơ-ra-ên, chưa từng có việc gì như vậy tại đó.

ko.L: 그리고 예루살렘에 큰 기쁨이 있었다. 이스라엘 왕 다윗의 아들 솔로몬의 날들 이후로 예루살렘에 이와 같은 [일이] 없었기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그래서 예루살렘에는 큰 기쁨이 있었다. 이스라엘 왕 다윗의 아들 솔로몬 시대 이후로 예루살렘에서 이런 일이 없었기 때문이다.
ko.R: 예루살렘은 기쁨으로 가득 찼다. 이스라엘 전체를 다스렸던 다윗의 아들 솔로몬 왕 시대 이후로 그곳에서 이런 일은 한 번도 없었다.

pt.L: E houve grande alegria em Jerusalém, porque desde os dias de Salomão, filho de Davi, rei de Israel, [não tinha havido] nada como isto em Jerusalém.
pt.B: Houve, então, grande alegria em Jerusalém, porque desde o tempo de Salomão, filho de Davi, rei de Israel, nada como aquilo tinha acontecido em Jerusalém.
pt.R: Jerusalém ficou cheia de alegria. Nada parecido tinha acontecido ali desde o tempo do rei Salomão, filho de Davi, que governou todo o Israel.

decisions.choice: since the days of Solomon son of David king of Israel
decisions.reason: Solomon was the last king over all twelve tribes, and at the dedication of the temple all Israel feasted together for fourteen days (7:8-10). Since the kingdom split (chapter 10) the north and the south had not worshiped together in Jerusalem like this. The comparison is about the gathering and its joy; Josiah's Passover is said to surpass all others since the days of Samuel (35:18).

decisions.choice: nothing like this: the verb is left out
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says simply "not like this", leaving the reader to supply "there had been".

decisions.choice: who ruled all Israel (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable explains "king of Israel" here as king over the whole undivided people, since elsewhere in the book Israel names the northern kingdom.

records.literal_gloss: And arose the priests the Levites and blessed the people, and was heard their voice, and came their prayer to [the] dwelling of his holiness, to the heavens.

en.L: And the priests the Levites arose and blessed the people, and their voice was heard, and their prayer came to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy dwelling, to the heavens.
en.B: Then the Levitical priests stood and blessed the people. Their voice was heard, and their prayer reached heaven, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy dwelling place.
en.R: Then the priests, who were from the tribe of Levi, stood up and blessed the people. God heard them. Their prayer reached heaven, the holy place where {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} lives.

es.L: Y se levantaron los sacerdotes levitas y bendijeron al pueblo, y su voz fue oída, y su oración llegó a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santa morada, a los cielos.
es.B: Entonces los sacerdotes levitas se levantaron y bendijeron al pueblo. Su voz fue oída, y su oración llegó al cielo, {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santa morada.
es.R: Entonces los sacerdotes, que eran de la tribu de Leví, se pusieron de pie y bendijeron al pueblo. Dios los escuchó. Su oración llegó hasta el cielo, el lugar santo donde {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} vive.

fr.L: Et les prêtres, les Lévites, se levèrent et bénirent le peuple, et leur voix fut entendue, et leur prière parvint à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} sainte demeure, aux cieux.
fr.B: Alors les prêtres lévites se levèrent et bénirent le peuple. Leur voix fut entendue, et leur prière parvint jusqu’au ciel, {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} sainte demeure.
fr.R: Ensuite les prêtres, qui étaient de la tribu de Lévi, se sont levés et ils ont béni le peuple. Dieu les a entendus. Leur prière est arrivée jusqu’au ciel, le lieu saint où {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} habite.

sw.L: Ndipo makuhani Walawi wakainuka, wakawabariki watu, na sauti yao ikasikiwa, na maombi yao yakafika kwenye makao {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} matakatifu, mbinguni.
sw.B: Kisha makuhani wa Kilawi walisimama, wakawabariki watu. Sauti yao ilisikiwa, na maombi yao yakafika mbinguni, makao {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} matakatifu.
sw.R: Kisha makuhani, waliotoka kabila la Lawi, walisimama wakawabariki watu. Mungu aliwasikia. Maombi yao yalifika mbinguni, mahali patakatifu anapoishi.

vi.L: Các thầy tế lễ người Lê-vi đứng dậy chúc phước cho dân chúng; tiếng họ được nghe, và lời cầu nguyện của họ thấu đến nơi ngự thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, đến tận trời.
vi.B: Bấy giờ các thầy tế lễ người Lê-vi đứng dậy chúc phước cho dân chúng. Tiếng họ được nhậm, và lời cầu nguyện của họ thấu đến trời, là nơi ngự thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Rồi các thầy tế lễ thuộc chi tộc Lê-vi đứng dậy chúc phước cho dân chúng. Đức Chúa Trời nghe họ. Lời cầu nguyện của họ thấu đến trời, là nơi thánh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ngự.

ko.L: 그리고 레위인 제사장들이 일어나 백성을 축복했다. 그리고 그들의 소리가 들렸고, 그들의 기도가 그분의 거룩한 처소, 하늘에 이르렀다.
ko.B: 레위인 제사장들이 일어나 백성을 축복했다. 그들의 목소리가 들렸고, 그들의 기도가 그분의 거룩한 처소인 하늘에 이르렀다.
ko.R: 그러자 레위 지파 출신의 제사장들이 일어나 백성을 축복했다. 하나님께서 그들의 목소리를 들으셨다. 그들의 기도는 그분께서 계시는 거룩한 곳, 하늘에까지 닿았다.

pt.L: E os sacerdotes, os levitas, se levantaram e abençoaram o povo; e a voz deles foi ouvida, e a oração deles chegou à {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} santa habitação, aos céus.
pt.B: Então os sacerdotes levitas se levantaram e abençoaram o povo. A voz deles foi ouvida, e a oração deles chegou ao céu, a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} santa habitação.
pt.R: Então os sacerdotes, que eram da tribo de Levi, se levantaram e abençoaram o povo. Deus os ouviu. A oração deles chegou ao céu, o lugar santo onde {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} mora.

decisions.choice: the priests the Levites: the Levitical priests
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text reads "the priests the Levites", the phrase Deuteronomy uses for the priests as members of the tribe of Levi (Deuteronomy 18:1; compare 2 Chronicles 5:5; 23:18). Some Hebrew manuscripts and ancient translations read "the priests and the Levites", as in verses 15, 21 and 25. The record follows the Hebrew text; blessing the people was the priests' task (Numbers 6:23-27).

decisions.choice: their prayer came to his holy dwelling, to heaven
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 26:15 prays, "Look down from your holy dwelling, from heaven", and Solomon asked Yahweh to hear from heaven, his dwelling place, every prayer made toward the temple (6:21, 30). The chapter ends with that prayer answered.

decisions.choice: their voice was heard: God heard them
decisions.reason: The verb is passive and does not name who heard. The next clause shows it was Yahweh in heaven.

decisions.choice: God heard them (Readable); the priests, who were from the tribe of Levi (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the one who heard (m3) and explains "the priests the Levites" (m1). Balanced says "the Levitical priests".

decisions.choice: os sacerdotes, os levitas (L); os sacerdotes levitas (B); os sacerdotes, que eram da tribo de Levi (R); a sua santa habitação
decisions.reason: The priests are named as 5:5 names them in Portuguese, one wording per level (m1). Their prayer reaches "a sua santa habitação", the words of Deuteronomy 26:15 in Portuguese (m2); "deles" keeps the priests' prayer apart from God's dwelling.
